_comment: Cue list for Squatch Life. Two kinds live here. A cue with `prompt` is a sound effect and goes to ElevenLabs sound-generation. A cue with `say` is a line of dialogue and goes to text-to-speech using the voice named in `voice`, resolved against the `voices` block below. Run `npm run sfx` for everything, `npm run sfx:vo` for just the spoken lines. Any cue without a file falls back to the built-in WebAudio synth, so the game is playable either way.

voices._comment: Every spoken line resolves its voice here, so the character sounds like one person. Paste an ElevenLabs voice id into `id` -- `npm run sfx:voices` lists what is on your account. Nothing spoken will generate until this is set.

player._note: The man who lives here. Mid thirties, flat delivery, talks to himself because there is nobody else in. Not doing a bit -- he is just narrating his own afternoon to an empty room.

announcer._note: 97.8 THE SQUATCH station voice. Adverts, links and the automated overnight. Shouts everything. Low stability and high style on purpose -- this is the one voice allowed to be completely unhinged.

lou1._note: BIG UNCLE LOU SPUTTHOLE, in the room. The boss. Same performer as `lou`, which is him on the phone. NOT `lou2` -- that is Captain Lou Sasole, a different man, and the two must never merge. (This profile began life as one half of the radio show Lou & Lou; the id was reused for the boss and the old note described the wrong character.)

I thought I heard his voice from one of the mansion gaurds as well.' THE THIRTY-NINE vo.motel.rico.* TAKES ON DISK ARE STILL THE OLD PERFORMER: an id here is an instruction to the generator, not to the mp3s. Every one of Rico's takes predates the take ledger, so all thirty-nine are stamped 'assumed' and carry no voiceId for `npm run check:takes` to measure this drift against -- which is exactly the hole the ledger's own header warns about, in the one case it cannot see. The recast is therefore also recorded in assets/sfx/rerecord.json, where a human reading the queue will find it. Regenerate with `npm run sfx -- --force --cast motel-rico`, then `npm run sfx:listen` and `npm run vo:takes`.

kittenboss._note: Kittenboss -- the OTHER prospect, and the woman in the boot of the car in THE SPECIAL MEETING. SHE, everywhere: dialogue, subtitles and direction alike. Aggrieved, deadpan, weirdly chipper: she treats having been shut in a boot for forty-two minutes as a logistics failure rather than a crime, and she is genuinely more annoyed about the spare wheel than about any of it. She is not startled to be there, she does not ask to be let out, and she never once sounds rescued -- she sounds like somebody whose lift was badly organised. Same age and same rank as Tony, which is the point -- do not play her as comic relief and never as frightened. The dry ones ('It was not forty minutes.' / 'I am annoyed. That is different.') are flat and completely sincere, and there is no wink in any of them. The two on the trail ('Are we allowed to talk?' / 'No. I had nothing. Sorry.') are the only quiet she gets, and even those land matter-of-fact rather than scared. CAST 2026-08-20 from the id the owner supplied, which is a woman's voice.

sfx._comment: Tony's half of the campaign calls. Every call in the flat used to be one man talking and a silence where the other one was; `<bank>.tony.<n>` is what he says back to line <n> of that bank, in the player voice, and it lives in the caller's own bank so a call is one folder. sfx._comment: Measured against every other weapon fire in the bank, this take is the problem and the code is not. Its encoded envelope peaks well below the 9mm, the carbine and the 12-gauge and is back at the noise floor inside a quarter of a second, and it FADES IN over roughly two hundred milliseconds instead of starting on a transient — a gunshot with no crack. The Motel plays it at unity (0.75 from the weapon system times the catalog's 1.34 revolver mix), so there is no gain left to add in software. It needs a louder, harder take.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.start.rightBalk-2.1
sfx.say: Again.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.start.rightCatch-1.1
sfx.say: There she is.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.start.brake-1.1
sfx.say: Parking brake off. Gently. They’re more of a written suggestion.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.lineup.begin-1.1
sfx.say: Run-up is good. Follow the arrow onto runway eighteen, point the nose south, then stop on the centerline.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.lineup.ready-1.1
sfx.say: There. Centerline under your nose. Full power when you are ready; at sixty, ease her off.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.taxi.route-1.1
sfx.say: Follow the faded yellow line out of the apron. It jogs right to the double bars at runway eighteen.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.taxi.begin-1.1
sfx.say: Taxi out. Little bursts of power, then let her roll.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.taxi.begin-2.1
sfx.say: She doesn’t steer like a truck. She steers like an argument.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.taxi.fast-1.1
sfx.say: Slow down. We’re not late for anything that matters.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.taxi.hold-1.1
sfx.say: Hold here. Feet on the brakes, run them both up.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.runup.sputter-1.1
sfx.say: Did that fix it?

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.runup.sputter-2.1
sfx.say: It changed the situation.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.runup.done-1.1
sfx.say: Good enough. Line up.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.takeoff.brief-1.1
sfx.say: Full power. Keep it straight. At sixty, pull back gently.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.takeoff.brief-2.1
sfx.say: What happens at sixty?

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.takeoff.brief-3.1
sfx.say: We find out if I remembered the number.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.takeoff.rotate-1.1
sfx.say: That’s sixty. Ease her off.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.takeoff.trees-1.1
sfx.say: Trees. Trees are the last part of the runway nobody paves.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.takeoff.clear-1.1
sfx.say: Congratulations. You have now flown exactly far enough to be blamed.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.takeoff.fly-1.1
sfx.say: Let me hear you fly.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.takeoff.fly-2.1
sfx.say: You are piping hot right now. El Hueso is south; keep the white diamond and compass arrow centered.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.takeoff.okay-1.1
sfx.say: Ohhhh kay.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.takeoff.grass-1.1
sfx.say: That’s the grass. The grass is not the runway.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.takeoff.grass-2.1
sfx.say: Bring her back round and do it with more conviction.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.takeoff.behind-1.1
sfx.say: You have gone backwards off the end of a runway.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.takeoff.behind-2.1
sfx.say: The pines behind us are not a taxiway. Nothing back there is.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.takeoff.behind-3.1
sfx.say: Round the front. Same runway. Other direction.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.takeoff.stranded-1.1
sfx.say: We’re in the trees.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.takeoff.stranded-2.1
sfx.say: We are. And the tow is me and a rope and my whole afternoon.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.takeoff.stranded-3.1
sfx.say: Sit still. I will put us back on the numbers and we will never speak of it.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.cruise.what-1.1
sfx.say: What exactly are we picking up?

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.cruise.what-2.1
sfx.say: Beef jerky.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.cruise.what-3.1
sfx.say: That’s it?

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.cruise.what-4.1
sfx.say: Rare beef jerky.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.cruise.what-5.1
sfx.say: How rare?

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.cruise.what-6.1
sfx.say: Possession is a customs event.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.cruise.photo-1.1
sfx.say: This is mountain-cured, pepper-crusted Silverback Reserve. Every strip has a serial number.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.cruise.photo-2.1
sfx.say: Why is it illegal?

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.cruise.photo-3.1
sfx.say: Trade agreement. Agricultural rules. Three senators own competing smokehouses. Pick a villain.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.nav.tower-1.1
sfx.say: Broken tower on the nose. Keep it off your left wing and hold what you’ve got.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.nav.river-1.1
sfx.say: River bent like a horseshoe. Follow the open end.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.nav.volcano-1.1
sfx.say: Volcano. Don’t fly through the smoke, it’s rude.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.nav.cliff-1.1
sfx.say: Red cliff. After that it’s all jungle and bad ideas.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.turb.start-1.1
sfx.say: Air’s getting lumpy. That’s the mountains breathing.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.turb.sick-1.1
sfx.say: I need you to fly smoother.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.turb.sick-2.1
sfx.say: I don’t know how.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.turb.sick-3.1
sfx.say: Then learn before my shirt becomes evidence.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.turb.bag-1.1
sfx.say: There are receipts in the sick bag. I’m putting it back.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.approach.falls-1.1
sfx.say: See that waterfall?

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.approach.falls-2.1
sfx.say: Yes.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.approach.falls-3.1
sfx.say: Fly toward it.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.approach.falls-4.1
sfx.say: There’s a mountain behind it.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.approach.falls-5.1
sfx.say: The runway is before the mountain.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.approach.falls-6.1
sfx.say: That feels important.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.approach.valley-1.1
sfx.say: Down into the valley. Power back, flaps out, and pick your line early.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.approach.valley-2.1
sfx.say: You get one. There is no going round again in here.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.approach.high-1.1
sfx.say: Too high.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.approach.high2-1.1
sfx.say: Still too high.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.approach.high3-1.1
sfx.say: Now you’re proving a point.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.approach.low-1.1
sfx.say: Low. Add power before the trees do it for you.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.approach.slow-1.1
sfx.say: Power. Power. POWER.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.approach.fast-1.1
sfx.say: We’re landing here, not in the next country.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.approach.flare-1.1
sfx.say: Hold it off. Hold it. Let her sit down.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.landing.good-1.1
sfx.say: That was a landing. I want that noted somewhere.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.landing.rough-1.1
sfx.say: We arrived before the important pieces fell off. Count it.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.landing.bad-1.1
sfx.say: Some of that was flying.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.landing.bad-2.1
sfx.say: Shut it down before anything else agrees to come off.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.cecilio.cecilio.meet-1.1
sfx.say: Grass-fed. Cold-smoked. Forty-two days in mountain air.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.cecilio.meet-2.1
sfx.say: It looks like jerky.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.cecilio.silence-1.1
sfx.say: He’s new.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.cecilio.cecilio.silence-2.1
sfx.say: This is not gas-station meat.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.cecilio.silence-3.1
sfx.say: Understood.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.cecilio.cecilio.silence-4.1
sfx.say: This jerky has lineage.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.load.brief-1.1
sfx.say: Three crates. Three positions. One in each and she flies like an aeroplane.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.load.brief-2.1
sfx.say: All three in the back and she flies like a seesaw.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.load.tail-1.1
sfx.say: Move one forward unless you want the plane climbing before the runway starts.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.load.nose-1.1
sfx.say: We’re hauling jerky, not trying to drill for oil with the nose.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.load.strap-1.1
sfx.say: Strap them. Loose cargo is just weight that gets a vote.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.load.done-1.1
sfx.say: Door shut and latched. Say it out loud so I hear you say it.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.lookout.depart.engine-1.1
sfx.say: (radio, urgent) Motor. Two valleys over, coming this way.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.cecilio.depart.engine-2.1
sfx.say: Aeroplane. Bureau. Go now.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.depart.lou-1.1
sfx.say: You’re flying back.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.depart.lou-2.1
sfx.say: I barely landed.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.depart.lou-3.1
sfx.say: And now you’re experienced.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.depart.seat-1.1
sfx.say: Wake me if an engine quits.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.depart.seat-2.1
sfx.say: Which engine?

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.depart.seat-3.1
sfx.say: The loud one.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.depart.downhill-1.1
sfx.say: Downhill. The arrow on the barrel is not decoration.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.depart.downhill-2.1
sfx.say: Keep it rolling.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.depart.runway-1.1
sfx.say: We’re running out of runway.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.depart.runway-2.1
sfx.say: Then stop looking at it.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.depart.clear-1.1
sfx.say: Cliff. That’s the good kind of nothing underneath you.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.return.river-1.1
sfx.say: Stay near the river.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.return.river-2.1
sfx.say: Why?

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.return.river-3.1
sfx.say: Because rivers rarely build towers.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.return.ridge-1.1
sfx.say: Ridge ahead. Left side.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.return.ridge-2.1
sfx.say: The left side has trees.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.return.ridge-3.1
sfx.say: The right side has government.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.return.rain-1.1
sfx.say: Rain. Good. Nobody looks up in it.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.caib.caib.sweep-1.1
sfx.say: ...sector four, negative contact, continuing the pattern.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.caib.sweep-2.1
sfx.say: They’re sweeping. Get lower.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.caib.caib.hail-1.1
sfx.say: Unidentified cargo aircraft, alter course and prepare for agricultural inspection.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.caib.hail-2.1
sfx.say: Do not answer.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.caib.hail-3.1
sfx.say: They know we’re here.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.caib.hail-4.1
sfx.say: Knowing and proving are cousins, not twins.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.caib.chase-1.1
sfx.say: Behind us. Don’t climb — climbing is how you introduce yourself.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.caib.chase-2.1
sfx.say: Canyon, cloud, or the saddle in that ridge. Pick one and commit.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.caib.lost-1.1
sfx.say: Gone. Or bored. Both spend the same.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.caib.boundary-1.1
sfx.say: That range behind us is the whole argument. We’re somebody else’s paperwork now.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.engine.hot-1.1
sfx.say: Left one’s running hot. Ease back the left throttle.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.engine.hot-2.1
sfx.say: We need both engines.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.engine.hot-3.1
sfx.say: That is why the plane came with two.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.engine.cooling-1.1
sfx.say: Let it sulk. Fly the other one.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.engine.recovered-1.1
sfx.say: Temperature’s down. Give it half and don’t apologise to it.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.home.sight-1.1
sfx.say: That’s the field. Same as you left it, which is the best it does.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.home.sight-2.1
sfx.say: The runway lights are out.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.home.sight-3.1
sfx.say: They have been out since the county discovered invoices.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.home.sight-4.1
sfx.say: How do I see the runway?

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.home.headlights-1.1
sfx.say: Community support.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.home.final-1.1
sfx.say: Crosswind from the left. Point the nose into it and land on the wheel that’s low.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.home.brake-1.1
sfx.say: Feet down. Hold the brakes and keep her straight. We still need the hangar.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.end.bucket-1.1
sfx.say: So that was the job?

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.end.bucket-2.1
sfx.say: That was the interview.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.associate.end.crew-1.1
sfx.say: Sasole. You’re green.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.end.crew-2.1
sfx.say: I have been green since the mountains. Take the middle one first.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.end.crew-3.1
sfx.say: Should I help?

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.end.crew-4.1
sfx.say: You flew it here. That was your half.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.end.bite-1.1
sfx.say: Worth it.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.prospect.end.envelope-1.1
sfx.say: This is my cut?

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.end.envelope-2.1
sfx.say: You’re still a prospect.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.end.envelope-3.1
sfx.say: Same time tomorrow. Bring a bag for me and nothing for you.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-stall-1.1
sfx.say: Nose down! The sky is not holding meetings today!

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-stall-2.1
sfx.say: Nose down. Down. The other down.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-stall-3.1
sfx.say: You’re out of speed and ideas. Fix the speed one.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-overspeed-1.1
sfx.say: Ease off. She starts shedding parts as a hint.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-overspeed-2.1
sfx.say: That noise is the airframe filing a complaint.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-terrain-1.1
sfx.say: Ground. Ground is a solid.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-terrain-2.1
sfx.say: Up. Now would be the time.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-gearHard-1.1
sfx.say: Feel that? That was the landing gear’s entire remaining career.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-gearHard-2.1
sfx.say: That noise came out of the maintenance budget.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-gearHard-3.1
sfx.say: If the wheels are still round, buy them dinner.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-banked-1.1
sfx.say: Level it. My coffee has opinions.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-banked-2.1
sfx.say: That’s a lot of angle for a man with my stomach.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-smooth-1.1
sfx.say: That’s better. Keep doing whatever that was.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-smooth-2.1
sfx.say: Good. Boring. Boring is the whole job.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-smooth-3.1
sfx.say: There. Small inputs. The plane likes that.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-rough-1.1
sfx.say: Easy on the yoke. You are flying an aeroplane, not shaking a vending machine.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-rough-2.1
sfx.say: Stop stirring the sky. Small inputs.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-rough-3.1
sfx.say: Your hands have opinions. I need them to have fewer.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-holy-1.1
sfx.say: Holee leee.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-holy-2.1
sfx.say: If you meant to do that, never do it again.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-holy-3.1
sfx.say: My stomach just filed a transfer request.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-offCourseLeft-1.1
sfx.say: Marker is left. Turn left and bring the diamond back into the glass.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-offCourseLeft-2.1
sfx.say: You are right of course. Ease left; the compass is asking politely.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-offCourseLeft-3.1
sfx.say: The arrow wants left. It is better at directions than either of us.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-offCourseRight-1.1
sfx.say: Marker is right. Turn right and put the diamond back in the middle.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-offCourseRight-2.1
sfx.say: You are left of course. Ease right; the compass is asking politely.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-offCourseRight-3.1
sfx.say: The arrow wants right. It is better at directions than either of us.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-taxiLost-1.1
sfx.say: Yellow line to the double bars. That is hold short for runway eighteen.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-taxiLost-2.1
sfx.say: The runway is east of the apron. Follow the yellow stripe; we painted it for this exact moment.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-cargoShift-1.1
sfx.say: Something moved back there. That is never good news.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-cargoShift-2.1
sfx.say: The jerky changed seats. Fly like it has another vote.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-cargoShift-3.1
sfx.say: Cargo is walking around back there. Smooth it out.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-patrolClose-1.1
sfx.say: Lower. Trees are free cover and nobody bills you for them.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-patrolClose-2.1
sfx.say: Keep the ridge between us and the badge.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-patrolClose-3.1
sfx.say: Cloud or canyon. Either one has fewer forms.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-cruise-1.1
sfx.say: Hold this line. The aeroplane finally believes you.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-cruise-2.1
sfx.say: That is good flying. Do not celebrate where the plane can hear you.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-cruise-3.1
sfx.say: Needles steady, cargo quiet. This is the part nobody puts in the movie.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-cruise-4.1
sfx.say: Keep the diamond centered and let the engines earn their fuel.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-cruise-5.1
sfx.say: Small corrections. We are smuggling beef, not wrestling weather.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-cruise-6.1
sfx.say: Look outside once in a while. The mountains are doing most of the navigating.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-finalLine-1.1
sfx.say: Runway is under the lights. Bring the nose back to center.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-finalLine-2.1
sfx.say: You are drifting off the pavement. Correct gently.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-finalLine-3.1
sfx.say: Centerline first. Pride later.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-finalFast-1.1
sfx.say: Too fast for this runway. Power back and let the nose rise.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-finalFast-2.1
sfx.say: Slow it down. Asphalt is cheaper than forest, but there is less of it.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-finalFast-3.1
sfx.say: We need wheels on pavement, not a low pass for the county.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-finalHigh-1.1
sfx.say: You are high. Power back and follow the light ladder down.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-finalHigh-2.1
sfx.say: The runway is below us, which is useful only if we descend.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-finalHigh-3.1
sfx.say: Ease the nose down. We are out of sky before we are out of runway.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-finalFlare-1.1
sfx.say: Eyes at the far end. Hold it off.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-finalFlare-2.1
sfx.say: Easy now. Let the runway come to you.

sfx.name: vo.beefrun.sasole.bark-finalFlare-3.1
sfx.say: Small pull. Keep it straight. Let her settle.

sfx.name: woo.up
sfx.prompt: short warm upward two-note chime on a vibraphone, soft mallet, small room, quiet and unfussy, no music bed

sfx.name: woo.down
sfx.prompt: short muted downward two-note vibraphone figure, soft mallet, slightly flat, small room, no music bed

sfx.name: woo.streak
sfx.prompt: small bright rising vibraphone flourish with a soft shimmer tail, celebratory but restrained, supper club scale

sfx.name: tip.fold
sfx.prompt: a folded banknote pressed into a palm and closed around, soft paper crease and fabric, very close mic, dry

sfx.name: vo.news.tv.big_night.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.ceremony.speech-booskibro.107itai.1
sfx.say: Brothers. Sisters. Silverbacks of the Circle.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.ceremony.speech-booskibro.040hws8.1
sfx.say: Before there were bandanas... there was a fire. And before this fire... there were FIVE.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.ceremony.speech-booskibro.0fec4lv.1
sfx.say: Five who walked out of their apartments and into the pines. Five who heard the forest — and answered it.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.ceremony.speech-booskibro.1e5jis7.1
sfx.say: Tonight, five prospects stand where the five once stood. The forest is watching. I am ALSO watching.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.ceremony.speech-big-uncle-lou-sputthole.0t0savl.1
sfx.say: What Booskibro means is: welcome. This is a family. A large, damp, forest family.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.ceremony.speech-big-uncle-lou-sputthole.08fkjpd.1
sfx.say: Also — whoever keeps leaving beer cans at the fire pit, knock it off. The raccoons are ORGANIZING.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.ceremony.speech-booskibro.0encv1g.1
sfx.say: ENOUGH. Prospects! Your first trial is not of the body... but of the MIND.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.ceremony.q1-booskibro.0725496.1
sfx.say: Prospect One. Step forward.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.ceremony.q1-booskibro.0yt30rc.1
sfx.say: Who are the FIVE founding members of the Silver Sasquatches?

sfx.name: vo.initiation.ceremony.q1-prospect-one.1f8jlt2.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.ceremony.q1-big-uncle-lou-sputthole.1ow3urn.1
sfx.say: Oof.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.ceremony.q1-booskibro.0ax7uug.1
sfx.say: WRONG.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.ceremony.q2-big-uncle-lou-sputthole.1y1r41v.1
sfx.say: ...Anyway!

sfx.name: vo.initiation.ceremony.q2-booskibro.09kvaq9.1
sfx.say: Prospect Two. Same question.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.ceremony.q2-big-uncle-lou-sputthole.17vvp6d.1
sfx.say: No pressure. Well. Some pressure. A specific, recently demonstrated amount of pressure.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.ceremony.correct-booskibro.1y7kr1y.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.ceremony.correct-big-uncle-lou-sputthole.13n17t6.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.ceremony.correct-booskibro.0rokpd7.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.ceremony.wrong-booskibro.0ax7uug.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.ceremony.wrong-big-uncle-lou-sputthole.1ptheaa.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.ceremony.endured-booskibro.0puzx4p.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.ceremony.endured-booskibro.0jbhkiy.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.ceremony.anoint-booskibro.1q1dvvj.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.ceremony.anoint-booskibro.01hq6iv.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.ceremony.anoint-booskibro.008ri98.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.ceremony.prospect-two.159f04d.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.ceremony.prospect-two.09f28mj.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.ceremony.prospect-two.0gkbuto.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.booski.0noogwr.1
sfx.say: You did the reading. You have no idea how rare that is. The gecko guy did not do the reading.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.booski.13pbzks.1
sfx.say: THE MAN OF THE HOUR. Somebody get him something he can't refuse.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.booski.1fmhlyk.1
sfx.say: I've inducted forty men. I remember maybe six. You, I'll remember.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.booski.1vk1vra.1
sfx.say: You took the whole Gauntlet with your hands down. Deathmegatron cried a little. He'll deny it.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.booski.11vs05b.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.booski.0w0lg6e.1
sfx.say: You know what the founders had that nobody has anymore? …I forget. But you've got it too.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.booski.0jkj49u.1
sfx.say: You're my son now. Legally? No. Forest-legally? Absolutely. Do not test it.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.booski.19z7fti.1
sfx.say: The log. You broke the log. You want to know what it was for. …It was for that. Next question.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.booski.1vg0pqs.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.booski.1r7sdky.1
sfx.say: Come here. Closer. …No, closer. I want to see your eyes when I say welcome.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.booski.0jcxnfk.1
sfx.say: Rippinflow likes you. Rippinflow doesn't like anyone. Makes me wonder what he sees that I don't.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.lou.0lhhkjk.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.lou.1hu8qxr.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.lou.146tcl0.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.lou.1hyasxt.1
sfx.say: Somebody did the reading. Somebody gets to keep their fluids on the inside. Cheers to that.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.lou.0mz7unr.1
sfx.say: Genuinely proud of you. I might cry. I won't. But I might. That's between us.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.lou.07lpis4.1
sfx.say: Housekeeping while I've got you: the raccoons unionized. The little one has a clipboard now. Watch him.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.lou.0hdtwmo.1
sfx.say: You made it. Not everyone does. Don't look at the shirt by the truck. Look at me. You made it.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.lou.17d1pwa.1
sfx.say: You keep checking your waistband. Cold night? Or is there a reason your hand keeps going there.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.lou.1rsa6dq.1
sfx.say: I like you. So I'm going to say this once, friendly: whatever you're carrying, put it down before Booski's toast.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.rippinflow.044fod8.1
sfx.say: …You did good.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.rippinflow.06x0216.1
sfx.say: You didn't run. Smart. Nobody outruns the tree line.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.rippinflow.1ktpe8w.1
sfx.say: I was gonna have to be the one. If you'd failed. Glad I didn't.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.rippinflow.0h4gx85.1
sfx.say: You've got a shooter's hands. I noticed during the Gauntlet. You kept making a fist.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.rippinflow.0mjhqor.1
sfx.say: Whatever you came here to do. …I hope it was join us.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.shubes.1cn6ytd.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.shubes.04d2y7j.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.shubes.1hhm04m.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.shubes.1f1xfoo.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.shubes.1ls9vgm.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.shubes.1vp41wb.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.shubes.1fj8r6h.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.deathmegatron.0jlv5p9.1
sfx.say: Voice on this guy.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.deathmegatron.08rpeo6.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.deathmegatron.1mpvq3f.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.deathmegatron.05h0ma9.1
sfx.say: Brother.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.deathmegatron.0pyngtq.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.hogmama.1ahg85n.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.hogmama.0kumwmd.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.hogmama.05xn58u.1
sfx.say: Every man here I've patched up at least once. You're on the list now. Congratulations, I guess.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.hogmama.089tex1.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.hogmama.1cldrhn.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.hogmama.0tuh3wl.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.hogmama.0k6wgxr.1
sfx.say: Whatever you're planning, sweetheart — I do the cleanup. So do it somewhere with a tarp already down.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.ape.19628w6.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.ape.1i4431e.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.ape.0ijq4on.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.ape.09wkzum.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.ape.1wv0asm.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.ape.0wbojf4.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.ape.0igz9f6.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.ape.1gwjrcm.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.irish.1ln070f.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.irish.1g5h1uf.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.irish.03363if.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.irish.1ah08u7.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.erican.190z6i5.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.erican.0bdemm4.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.erican.1o3ynaq.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.party.erican.1jb6mll.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-260-booskibro.1gudewg.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-310-lou.1t6766a.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-320-lou.0p69cz0.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-330-booskibro.09hb3ch.1
sfx.say: You are here because of your deeds and the assertions of those who stand at your side.
sfx.direction: QUIET. He has boomed through the entire game; in here he does not, and the change is the point.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-340-booskibro.08uea1h.1
sfx.say: You did what was asked. You kept your mouth shut. You handled yourself at the Bing. You flew the beef run. When it came time to stand up, you stood up.
sfx.direction: A list being confirmed, not a compliment being paid.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-350-rippinflow.1hyk744.1
sfx.say: This life is one of secrecy. If you make a friend, meet a woman, live out there among regular people... they must not know about our thing.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-360-lou.1cj0ypn.1
sfx.say: It is binding. It is not forgiving. To betray one is to betray all.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-365-silent-lou.06zmzt5.1
sfx.say: You didn’t say anything out there.
sfx.direction: Quiet, private, meant for Tony and nobody else — and the room hears it anyway because the room is four metres wide. He is not asking and he does not wait for an answer.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-365-silent-lou.1hlgrfm.1
sfx.say: Good.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-370-lou.1o1uo7u.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-371-prospect.0v3lnxo.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.fail-b-prospect.0wv20kn.1

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-380-lou.1bwulo9.1
sfx.say: Then before the eyes of all here present... join me.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-410-lou.0zn68ys.1

sfx.direction: Not verbatim — connective tissue, and the shortest possible bridge into the input.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-430-lou.17nhb4i.1
sfx.say: To become a man of honor... repeat these words.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-430-lou.1800mnn.1
sfx.say: I swear my loyalty to this family.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-430-prospect.1800mnn.1
sfx.say: I swear my loyalty to this family.
sfx.direction: FLAT AND CAREFUL. He is not moved and he is not performing — he is a man repeating words correctly because he has understood that getting them wrong is a category of thing that has consequences here.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-435-lou.0aarlpi.1
sfx.say: My flesh must burn in hell like this saint if I do not keep my oath.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-435-prospect.0aarlpi.1
sfx.say: My flesh must burn in hell like this saint if I do not keep my oath.
sfx.direction: He says "like this saint" while holding the saint, and the game does not help him notice.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-450-lou.0qt3496.1
sfx.say: From this day forward, your word is the word of this family. Your enemies are our enemies. Your loyalty is no longer yours alone — it belongs to all of us.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-460-lou.08jlcav.1
sfx.say: Welcome.
sfx.direction: IN UNISON WITH BOOSKIBRO, QUIETLY. Two takes mixed to land on the same frame — it is not a line and a response, and if it queues one after the other the beat dies.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-460-booskibro.08jlcav.1
sfx.say: Welcome.
sfx.direction: IN UNISON WITH LOU, QUIETLY. Same frame as his.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-500-ape.0juxi7h.1
sfx.say: SALUD!

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-500-hogmama.0juxi7h.1
sfx.say: SALUD!

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-500-sasole.0juxi7h.1
sfx.say: SALUD!

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-510-eric.0gfm3yw.1
sfx.say: Salud, kid.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-510-snow.0k2r3sk.1
sfx.say: You’re family now.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-510-irish.046pkld.1
sfx.say: That’s it, brother.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-510-numbskull.1u7dsrm.1
sfx.say: He made it.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-510-seff.02uoq5p.1
sfx.say: Salud!

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-510-hogmama.1nr42bj.1
sfx.say: Come here. Come here, baby.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-510-ape.0xst0zj.1
sfx.say: Look at his face. Look at it.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-510-ape.0zlwnzq.1
sfx.say: He’s gone grey. He’s actually gone grey.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-510-sasole.0fiu2nk.1
sfx.say: Still top five, this one.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-510-lag.1aak3yu.1
sfx.say: Congrats. Genuinely.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-510-rippinflow.1k732ys.1
sfx.say: Good. Now sit down.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-510-shubenator.1kfql4w.1
sfx.say: It’s the stove.
sfx.direction: Still going, and now there is a stove to blame.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-510-gratin.09pdb6x.1
sfx.say: There’s food. Nobody’s eating it.
sfx.direction: THE LINE TO PROTECT. An hour ago he shot three people on their knees and now he is quietly upset that his food is going cold, and he is not doing a bit — he cooked and nobody is eating. Exactly as flat as everything else he has said tonight.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-510-numbskull.1cws2gf.1
sfx.say: I said I liked him. I said that before.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-510-irish.1puj0x9.1
sfx.say: The card was fine, by the way. That was a proper card.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-510-booskibro.1ny7ol1.1
sfx.say: SIT HIM DOWN. Somebody sit him down.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-520-lou.13css28.1
sfx.say: Tonight, you became one of us. That means something.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-520-lou.1yrqj63.1
sfx.say: It also means every move you make reflects on me... and on this family. So don’t embarrass us.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-520-lou.0p8y88k.1
sfx.say: And don’t think this means you get to relax. You still got work to do.
sfx.direction: A faint smirk under this one — the first since IN-090, and very small. Lou is back, not all the way, and not tonight.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-530-booskibro.106nqi3.1
sfx.say: Drink. Tonight you earned it.

sfx.name: vo.initiation.cabin.in-530-prospect.1dbsrar.1
sfx.say: …Cheers.
sfx.direction: Optional, one only, and only if the player waits.

sfx.say: Rumors that the cargo was jerky remain unconfirmed. The smell, our reporter notes, does not.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.1u90o1i
sfx.say: The motel says it is open for business. The county road is not.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.1i92quw
sfx.say: From the lake — the search has been suspended after a boating incident left one man unaccounted for.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0j0s8av
sfx.say: The vessel returned to the marina with fewer passengers than it left with. The remaining passengers describe a calm and pleasant afternoon.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0hk4r6y
sfx.say: Nobody on board recalls the missing man being on board, including the man who invited him.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0npqmix
sfx.say: The lake has been asked for comment. The lake is calm.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.06cunix
sfx.say: Our top story remains the daylight robbery at Cumberland Fidelity, where an armed crew emptied the vault and shot their way out of downtown.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0rp9kjo
sfx.say: Every hostage walked out unharmed. Several describe the gunmen as polite, professional, and considerably larger than the doors.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0xnsees
sfx.say: Witnesses describe the man carrying the duffel bags as an unidentified large gentleman. Witnesses describe the other four the same way.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0ymg6a2
sfx.say: Police have released a description. The description is: large. Further details as they refuse to develop.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.1xb04qh
sfx.say: The bank reopens Monday. The vault, we are told, needs longer.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0jx3pgo
sfx.say: Police have confirmed an armed assault overnight on a private estate outside the city, repelled before officers arrived.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.1hwcfyz
sfx.say: The homeowner, described as a retired businessman, declined to be interviewed, photographed, or approached.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0z1j2c4
sfx.say: Neighbors report roughly twenty minutes of sustained gunfire, which the estate’s groundskeeper attributes to raccoons.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0oa8zlv
sfx.say: No arrests have been made. No attackers could be located to arrest.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.13i20ak
sfx.say: International news. Authorities overseas are investigating a large unexplained detonation outside a coastal city late last night.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.1mw08bf
sfx.say: Residents report a single aircraft, a very bright light, and a cloud one witness would only describe as historically shaped.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.1tbxjjr
sfx.say: Air-defense batteries were active for most of an hour. Officials confirm they hit nothing, and have asked us to emphasize that they were close.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.1qmracr
sfx.say: No group has claimed responsibility. Aviation records show no aircraft of that size registered to anybody sensible.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.1dsn9l5
sfx.say: Overseas again — officials are investigating an outbreak of violence at a fortified private compound south of the border.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0c5i559
sfx.say: The compound belonged to a businessman described in the regional press as an agricultural exporter, with the quotation marks audible.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.11yz7vl
sfx.say: Sources report a change of leadership in the local organization. The new leadership has not been named, located, or seen.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.10wwqon
sfx.say: Regional authorities have declared the matter internal, closed, and none of anyone’s business, in that order.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.06vu9sz
sfx.say: A strange one from the wire. The families of several research scientists say they have been unable to reach them for days.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0twgwum
sfx.say: Their employer cannot be reached either. Calls to the listed number reach a man who says there is no listed number.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0qgoe7f
sfx.say: The scientists were last seen leaving for a private contract at an undisclosed residence. That is the entire sentence we have been given.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.00eb7vf
sfx.say: Police are not treating the matter as suspicious, on the grounds that they have not been told about it.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.1v05271
sfx.say: That was one of ours. All of them are ours.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0rf28a0
sfx.say: Every record on this station was made by somebody in this group.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0cdawco
sfx.say: That is not a boast. It is closer to a disclosure.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.1keapkw
sfx.say: Requests are open. Requests have always been open. Nobody has ever rung.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.11ryahr
sfx.say: This one charted. Internally. Among us.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.035km9h
sfx.say: If you know the words, you were probably there when it was written.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0qdc8ax
sfx.say: Somebody mixed this in a basement on monitors that cost forty dollars.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.10fsahj
sfx.say: That was written in one night. You can tell. We are not hiding it.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0ttl6xr
sfx.say: No royalties have ever been paid. No royalties have ever been owed.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0rc2fyr
sfx.say: Turn it up. Nobody in this building is going to stop you.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.02o73bt
sfx.say: 97.8 The Squatch. The roster, on the roster.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0calrbi
sfx.say: Tape segment. A listener sent this in. Two wealthy men, left alone with their own laundry.

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.1wvrx46
sfx.say: One week a year. Every year. Our thoughts are with them.

sfx.name: radio.vo.unknown.0atce2d
sfx.say: — and he is still in the flat with y—

sfx.name: radio.vo.announcer.0177le3
sfx.say: …which is the traffic. Back to Lou.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.greetings
sfx.say: Greetings from the A-Team, bitch!
sfx.direction: Full-throat shout across a gunfight, delivered like a greeting he actually means. Cocky, hard, no smile in it.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.regards
sfx.say: A-Team sends their regards!
sfx.direction: Shouted while moving. A message being delivered, not a taunt -- he thinks he is being courteous.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.house
sfx.say: This house belongs to the A-Team now!
sfx.direction: Flat and certain at volume. A statement of fact about property, not a boast.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.finished
sfx.say: You Squatches are finished!
sfx.direction: Contempt, shouted downrange. He is telling them something he considers already true.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.collect
sfx.say: Tell Lou the A-Team came to collect!
sfx.direction: Shouted at whoever is left to carry the message. This is business and he wants it passed on.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.knock
sfx.say: The A-Team does not knock twice!
sfx.direction: Hard, clipped. A house rule being explained under fire.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.street
sfx.say: A-Team owns this street tonight!
sfx.direction: Territorial roar. Pride in the crew, not in himself.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.nobody-walks
sfx.say: Nobody walks out of an A-Team job!
sfx.direction: Cold and matter-of-fact at full volume. A promise he has kept before.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.for-the-a-team
sfx.say: For the A-Team!
sfx.direction: Owner's line (FOR THE A TEAM!!!). Full battle roar going through a door -- the loudest thing this man says all night. Absolute sincerity, zero irony.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.never-made-playoffs
sfx.say: It doesn’t matter! The A-Team never made playoffs!
sfx.direction: Owner's line, and the heart of the whole gag. Shouted mid-firefight at nobody in particular: defiant, wounded, completely sincere. He is defending the team's honour and he believes he is winning the argument. NOT wry, NOT knowing -- the line must never sound like it hears itself.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.rules
sfx.say: A-Team rules!
sfx.direction: Owner's line (A TEAM RULES). Short, shouted like a chant off a terrace. Total conviction.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.never-be-on-it
sfx.say: You’ll never be on the A-Team!
sfx.direction: Owner's line. Shouted downrange as an insult, and he thinks it is a devastating one.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.for-the-a-team-two
sfx.say: For the A-Team!
sfx.direction: Second take of the owner's line on a different man. Harder and flatter than ateam5's roar -- more command than cheer.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.nobody-asked
sfx.say: Nobody asked about the playoffs!
sfx.direction: Answering an accusation nobody made. Instantly defensive, shouted over gunfire, genuinely aggrieved. Play it as a real grievance, never as a joke.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.still-standing
sfx.say: We never made playoffs and we are standing in your house!
sfx.direction: Triumphant and breathless, shouted while advancing. To him this settles the matter for good.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.say-it
sfx.say: Say one word about the playoffs! Say it!
sfx.direction: Furious, daring an opponent who has not said a word. He is looking for a second fight inside the first one.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.seeding
sfx.say: It was the seeding! It was always the seeding!
sfx.direction: An explanation he has given a hundred times and is tired of giving. Frustration, not humour.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.the-record
sfx.say: That record does not say what you think it says!
sfx.direction: Correcting somebody mid-assault. Patient for half a second, then not patient. Absolutely serious.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.not-the-measure
sfx.say: Playoffs are not the measure of a team!
sfx.direction: Stated like a principle, at volume. He believes this the way other men believe in God.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.ask-anybody
sfx.say: Ask anybody who watched us play! Ask them!
sfx.direction: Appealing to a witness who is not there. Loud, hurt, certain.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.not-qualified
sfx.say: Nobody in this house is qualified to bring up the playoffs!
sfx.direction: Contempt for the entire house. Nobody in it has said anything; he is ruling them out anyway.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.nine-seasons
sfx.say: Nine seasons together! You know what that takes?
sfx.direction: Genuine pride cracking into anger halfway through. The question at the end is real -- he wants an answer from a man he is shooting at.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.do-not-say-it
sfx.say: Do not stand there and say playoffs to me!
sfx.direction: A warning, low and hard, shouted through cover. The closest this crew comes to threatening somebody over a scheduling matter, and it is meant.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.schedule
sfx.say: Hardest schedule in the league! We showed up every week!
sfx.direction: Fast and defensive, shouted while moving or reloading. Facts he keeps loaded.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.standings-lie
sfx.say: Standings lie! Everybody knows standings lie!
sfx.direction: A man who has been saying this for years and is still right about it. Full volume, no doubt.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.reload-not-rebuild
sfx.say: We do not rebuild! We reload!
sfx.direction: Fires on the reload beat, so he is literally changing a magazine as he says it. Proud of the phrase and he means it flatly, not cleverly.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.best-crew
sfx.say: A-Team! Best crew that ever worked this coast!
sfx.direction: Roared. Straight pride, no irony anywhere in it.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.on-three
sfx.say: A-Team on three! One! Two!
sfx.direction: A real count, shouted to the men beside him, and he moves on two. Locker-room huddle energy carried into a breach and played completely straight.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.look-at-us
sfx.say: You are looking at the A-Team! Look at us!
sfx.direction: Arms-wide in the voice. He wants to be seen doing this.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.this-is-what
sfx.say: This is what the A-Team does!
sfx.direction: Flat and satisfied in the middle of violence. A craftsman naming his craft.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.nobody-plays
sfx.say: Nobody plays like the A-Team!
sfx.direction: Shouted over sustained fire. Sports word, murder context, and he hears no gap between them.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.undefeated-here
sfx.say: Undefeated in this house!
sfx.direction: Claiming a record in the middle of earning it. Fierce and premature.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.earned-his-spot
sfx.say: Every man on this team earned his spot!
sfx.direction: Defending the roster to nobody in particular. Loyal, hot, sincere.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.cannot-buy
sfx.say: You cannot buy a roster like this!
sfx.direction: Boasting about the crew as if to a rival owner. Loud and very pleased with himself.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.say-it-back
sfx.say: A-Team! Say it back!
sfx.direction: A call expecting a response, thrown at his own men and at the house. He is not joking and he will wait.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.deepest-bench
sfx.say: Deepest bench in the business!
sfx.direction: Shouted as more men come up behind him. Genuine organisational pride.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.franchise
sfx.say: You are getting hit by a franchise crew!
sfx.direction: Informing the enemy who they are dealing with. Hard, almost helpful.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.check-the-tape
sfx.say: Check the tape! Go and check the tape!
sfx.direction: Second half angrier than the first. He believes there is tape and he believes it exonerates the team.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.team-record
sfx.say: That is a team record and it stands!
sfx.direction: Settled fact, stated under fire. Finality, no room for discussion.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.every-yard
sfx.say: Nobody carried us! We earned every yard of this!
sfx.direction: Raw and from the chest. Defending the crew's entire history to a house that never asked about it.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.played-hurt
sfx.say: He played hurt! You hear me? He played hurt!
sfx.direction: Fires over a man who has just gone down. Real grief wearing a sportscaster's words -- the 'you hear me' is a demand to be heard, not a flourish. Do not soften it and do not smirk it.

sfx.name: vo.ateam.next-man-up
sfx.say: Next man up!
sfx.direction: Two words, flat, immediately after a casualty. Not callousness to him: it is how a team keeps going.

sfx.name: weapon.suppressed.pistol9.fire
sfx.prompt: a single suppressed 9mm pistol shot fired indoors, deep muted thump with a sharp mechanical crack still on the front of it and the slide cycling hard after, no ring, small tiled room, close, dry, no voice
sfx._note: NOT YET RECORDED. The Cartel Palace loadout runs a suppressor (src/cartel-palace/suppressor.js). Owner direction 2026-08-20: NOT a Hollywood pfft -- substantially muted versus weapon.pistol9.fire but it keeps a sharp mechanical crack. Layered under weapon.suppressed.action at every shot.

sfx.name: weapon.suppressed.carbine.fire
sfx.prompt: a single suppressed 5.56 carbine shot fired inside a stone corridor, hard flat crack with the supersonic snap intact and the muzzle blast swallowed, heavy bolt cycling into the tail, no architectural ring, close, dry, no voice
sfx._note: NOT YET RECORDED. Suppressed carbine for the Cartel Palace (src/cartel-palace/suppressor.js). Substantially quieter than weapon.carbine.fire, still an unmistakable rifle crack -- owner was explicit it must not become a pfft.

sfx.name: weapon.suppressed.ak47.fire
sfx.prompt: a single suppressed 7.62 rifle shot fired indoors, low heavy muted report with a hard crack on the leading edge, loud stamped-steel bolt carrier slamming through it, no muzzle ring, close, dry, no voice
sfx._note: NOT YET RECORDED. Suppressed AK for the Cartel Palace (src/cartel-palace/suppressor.js). Heavier and slower than weapon.suppressed.carbine.fire; the action is the loudest part.

sfx.name: weapon.suppressed.action
sfx.prompt: the mechanical action of a suppressed firearm alone with no report, bolt or slide travelling and locking, spring ring, one brass case flicking out and hitting tile, close, dry, no voice
sfx._note: NOT YET RECORDED. The mechanical layer the Cartel Palace lays on TOP of every suppressed shot at ~0.82 volume (src/cartel-palace/suppressor.js). Owner direction 2026-08-20: "mechanical action still audible" -- this is that half of the sound, and it is what keeps a quiet gun reading as a machine rather than an absence.

sfx.name: vo.palace.tony.evidence.still.spot.1
sfx.say: There’s a file open on that screen. That’s Sauce’s face on it.
sfx.direction: Quiet, to himself, stopping mid-step. Recognition — not narration.

sfx.name: vo.palace.tony.evidence.still.log.1
sfx.say: Sauce… what the hell were you doing here?
sfx.direction: Low. Genuinely asking a man who is not in the room. The anger has not arrived yet.

sfx.name: vo.palace.tony.evidence.uniform.spot.1
sfx.say: That’s Sauce’s. Pressed, hung, and nobody presses a hostage’s jacket.
sfx.direction: Flat. He is looking at laundry and hearing a whole story in it.

sfx.name: vo.palace.tony.evidence.uniform.log.1
sfx.say: His knives are still rolled. This keeps getting stranger.
sfx.direction: Under his breath. The strangeness is starting to cost him something.

sfx.name: vo.palace.tony.evidence.ledger.spot.1
sfx.say: A cob of corn on a cartel accountant’s desk. There is exactly one man who does that.
sfx.direction: Dry, almost amused, and then not amused at all by the end of the sentence.

sfx.name: vo.palace.tony.evidence.ledger.log.1
sfx.say: Every other Friday. In Mark’s own hand. So Sauce was involved.
sfx.direction: Ice-flat. This is the line where the rescue stops being a rescue.

sfx.name: vo.palace.tony.evidence.complete.1
sfx.say: Six months I tore this state apart for you. You were down here getting paid.
sfx.direction: Spoken to a man who is two rooms away and does not know it yet. Very still.

sfx.name: vo.palace.tony.cleared.entry.1
sfx.say: Front hall’s clear. Nobody left standing in here who works for a living.
sfx.direction: Breathing hard, checking corners. A man counting bodies, not celebrating.

sfx.name: vo.palace.tony.cleared.halls.1
sfx.say: That’s the wing. Whole floor’s gone quiet.
sfx.direction: Lower. The quiet is worse than the noise and he knows it.

sfx.name: vo.palace.tony.cleared.estate.1
sfx.say: Nobody else coming. Just me and whatever’s behind those doors.
sfx.direction: Flat, final, already moving toward the dining room.

sfx.name: vo.palace.cleaner.spotted.1
sfx.say: Oh — oh no. No. No, no, no—
sfx.direction: A woman who has just seen a rifle in a house she mops. Rising, not screaming yet.

sfx.name: vo.palace.cleaner.panic.one.1
sfx.say: Don’t shoot! Don’t shoot! Please!
sfx.direction: Full volume, both hands up, backing away. Terror, absolutely sincere.

sfx.name: vo.palace.cleaner.panic.two.1
sfx.say: I only clean! I clean the floors, that is all I do!
sfx.direction: Shouted like a credential. She believes it will help because it is true.

sfx.name: vo.palace.cleaner.cower.one.1
sfx.say: Madre de Dios. Madre de Dios…
sfx.direction: Face down, hands over her head, repeating it into the tile.

sfx.name: vo.palace.cleaner.cower.two.1
sfx.say: I have children. Please. I have children.
sfx.direction: Small and fast, into the floor. Not bargaining — reciting.

sfx.name: vo.palace.cleaner.plead.1
sfx.say: Take anything. Take everything. Just go. Please just go.
sfx.direction: Exhausted terror, from the floor, as the player walks past her.

sfx.name: vo.palace.guard.watch.greet.1
sfx.say: Deliveries go round the back, friend. Round the— hey. HEY.
sfx.direction: Bored, half-looking up from a keyboard, and then all the way awake by "hey".

sfx.name: vo.palace.guard.contact.one.1
sfx.say: Contact! We’ve got a man inside the house!
sfx.direction: Shouted down a corridor. Professional, not panicked.

sfx.name: vo.palace.guard.contact.two.1
sfx.say: Eyes up! Eyes up, he’s in the wing!
sfx.direction: Barked to somebody else, already moving to an angle.

sfx.name: vo.palace.guard.contact.three.1
sfx.say: Somebody wake Mister Mark. Now.
sfx.direction: Hard and quiet. The worst part of his night is telling the boss.

sfx.name: vo.palace.guard.search.one.1
sfx.say: I heard something. Down that way.
sfx.direction: Uncertain, half to himself, weapon coming up an inch.

sfx.name: vo.palace.guard.search.two.1
sfx.say: Check it. I’m not getting shot over a cat.
sfx.direction: Irritated. He wants very much for this to be nothing.

sfx.name: vo.palace.guard.ally-down.one.1
sfx.say: He’s down! Somebody just put him down!
sfx.direction: Real shock in it. He knew the man.

sfx.name: vo.palace.guard.ally-down.two.1
sfx.say: Man down in the hall! Get up here!
sfx.direction: Shouted into the house. Calling for people, not answering.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.record.01.1
sfx.say: You hear what the A-Team did in Jersey Tuesday? Big house. Old money.
sfx.direction: Conversational, bored, filling a gap. Two men on a gate at two in the morning.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.record.02.1
sfx.say: I heard it was a mansion.
sfx.direction: Flat. Not impressed yet, just confirming the address.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.record.03.1
sfx.say: It was a mansion. Twenty-two guys, up the front drive, like they had an appointment.
sfx.direction: Warming up. He has been waiting all night to tell somebody this.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.record.04.1
sfx.say: No back door. No roof. Front.
sfx.direction: Slow, giving each one its own weight. That is the part that gets him.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.record.05.1
sfx.say: That is class. You cannot teach a man that.
sfx.direction: Sincere. He means it the way another man means it about a ballplayer.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.record.06.1
sfx.say: My cousin says they never made the playoffs. Not one year, not ever.
sfx.direction: Reporting it, not endorsing it. He already knows how this lands.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.record.07.1
sfx.say: Your cousin parks cars.
sfx.direction: Instant. Dead flat. Not a joke, a fact about the witness.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.record.08.1
sfx.say: He parks cars. I am telling you what he said.
sfx.direction: Defensive, small. He is not going to die on this hill.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.record.09.1
sfx.say: The playoffs are a bracket on a wall. A bracket has never once come through a door and taken a man’s house off him.
sfx.direction: Hard, level, absolutely serious. The most important thing he will say tonight.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.record.10.1
sfx.say: That is fair.
sfx.direction: Conceding. He has heard worse arguments from people with more education.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.record.11.1
sfx.say: Nine seasons. Nine. Not one playoff game, and every crew on this coast still says the name.
sfx.direction: Counting it out on his fingers. This is the defence and he has made it before.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.record.12.1
sfx.say: They do say it.
sfx.direction: Quiet agreement.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.record.13.1
sfx.say: You know how good you have to be to be that famous with nothing on the shelf?
sfx.direction: A genuine question. He wants the man to arrive at it himself.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.record.14.1
sfx.say: Very good.
sfx.direction: Arriving at it.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.record.15.1
sfx.say: The best. That is the only way that math works out. The best.
sfx.direction: Settled. Case closed, as far as he is concerned.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.record.16.1
sfx.say: I am not arguing with you. I said what my cousin said.
sfx.direction: Hands-up, tired. He would like to go back to standing quietly now.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.record.17.1
sfx.say: Then tell your cousin to go and park a car.
sfx.direction: The last word, taken. He turns back to the gate.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.overtime.01.1
sfx.say: They put me back on nights. Third week running.
sfx.direction: Aggrieved, low. Opening a complaint he has been saving.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.overtime.02.1
sfx.say: Nobody signed up for nights.
sfx.direction: Automatic solidarity. He has his own version of this.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.overtime.03.1
sfx.say: Sixteen hours Thursday, and the man docks me forty minutes for the drive up.
sfx.direction: Genuinely angry now. Money, which is the only thing that is ever really the subject.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.overtime.04.1
sfx.say: The drive is not the shift. That is the rule.
sfx.direction: Reciting policy he does not believe in either.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.overtime.05.1
sfx.say: The drive is where I do my thinking.
sfx.direction: Deadpan. He means it.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.overtime.06.1
sfx.say: You know who does not get docked? The A-Team. Flat number, gate to gate, agreed before anybody puts a boot in a door.
sfx.direction: Admiring. Bringing up the professionals the way you bring up a better job.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.overtime.07.1
sfx.say: Flat, gate to gate. That is an outfit that respects itself.
sfx.direction: Reverent, almost. This is what he wants when he grows up.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.overtime.08.1
sfx.say: That is what a trophy actually is. A number, in your hand, before the work.
sfx.direction: Philosophical, and completely straight. He has thought about this a lot.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.overtime.09.1
sfx.say: And they have never won a thing.
sfx.direction: Not a criticism. He is setting his partner up and they both know it.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.overtime.10.1
sfx.say: Never won a thing. Never lost a man either. Pick which one you want cut into your stone.
sfx.direction: Hard and quiet. The one line of the night either of them will remember.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.overtime.11.1
sfx.say: I want the second one.
sfx.direction: Immediate.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.overtime.12.1
sfx.say: Everybody wants the second one. Nobody trains for it.
sfx.direction: Turning back to the water. Conversation over as far as he is concerned.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.door.01.1
sfx.say: It is your door tonight.
sfx.direction: Opening shot, from a man who came all the way up the corridor to say it.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.door.02.1
sfx.say: It is not my door. I had the door Sunday, and Sunday is two doors.
sfx.direction: Not even looking up from the keyboard. He has this argument weekly.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.door.03.1
sfx.say: Sunday is one door.
sfx.direction: Firm.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.door.04.1
sfx.say: Sunday is two doors, because the kitchen brings the ice in through the front, and that is a door.
sfx.direction: Patient, like a man explaining arithmetic to a child.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.door.05.1
sfx.say: The ice is not a door.
sfx.direction: Flat refusal.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.door.06.1
sfx.say: The ice is a door.
sfx.direction: Immovable. He will be saying this at his funeral.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.door.07.1
sfx.say: You know how the A-Team runs it? They have no door man. All twenty-two do the door.
sfx.direction: Changing tack, and immediately more interested than he was in the ice.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.door.08.1
sfx.say: That is because they arrive at the door. It is a different relationship.
sfx.direction: A distinction he considers important and technical.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.door.09.1
sfx.say: That is the whole job, though. Arrive at the door.
sfx.direction: Simple, sincere admiration for a simple, sincere business model.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.door.10.1
sfx.say: I would work for them tomorrow.
sfx.direction: Honest. He would.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.door.11.1
sfx.say: You would not last the week. They run drills.
sfx.direction: Not unkind. A realistic assessment of a friend.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.door.12.1
sfx.say: I would do drills. For that money I would do drills.
sfx.direction: Wounded, and still typing.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.kitchen.01.1
sfx.say: Did you eat?
sfx.direction: Two men in a long empty hallway. Somebody has to start.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.kitchen.02.1
sfx.say: There is a tray in the kitchen. It has been in the kitchen since the afternoon.
sfx.direction: Bleak. A statement about the tray and about the whole job.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.kitchen.03.1
sfx.say: What is on it?
sfx.direction: Already regretting the question.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.kitchen.04.1
sfx.say: Something with a bone in it. I would not.
sfx.direction: Final. He has made his decision about the tray.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.kitchen.05.1
sfx.say: Mister Mark eats at a table with a napkin the size of a bedsheet, and we get a bone.
sfx.direction: Bitter, and quieter than the rest, because of where they are standing.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.kitchen.06.1
sfx.say: Do not say that in this hallway.
sfx.direction: Sharp. A real warning between friends.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.kitchen.07.1
sfx.say: I am saying it in this hallway.
sfx.direction: Quiet defiance. He does not raise his voice.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.kitchen.08.1
sfx.say: The A-Team eat before a job. Every man, sat down, hot food. That is in how they do it.
sfx.direction: Changing the subject to the only outfit either of them respects.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.kitchen.09.1
sfx.say: They have a book?
sfx.direction: Genuinely asking.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.kitchen.10.1
sfx.say: They have a way. Whether anybody wrote it down, I could not tell you.
sfx.direction: Careful. He does not want to overstate what he knows.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.kitchen.11.1
sfx.say: Nine years, no playoffs, and they still eat hot before they go in.
sfx.direction: Turning it over. The two facts sit together in his head as one fact.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.kitchen.12.1
sfx.say: Those two things are not connected.
sfx.direction: Mild correction.

sfx.name: vo.palace.shift.kitchen.13.1
sfx.say: I think they are connected.
sfx.direction: Certain. He is right and he knows it and he will not be moved.

sfx._comment: SM-010 — Idle, alone in the flat, before the call. On the apartment idle timer, one at a time, well spaced. He is not anxious yet. He is a man with nothing to do and nobody to tell.
sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.idle_before.1
sfx.say: Right. That's Sauce dealt with. That's a sentence I've said out loud now.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.idle_before.2
sfx.say: Nobody's rung. Nobody's rung all day.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.idle_before.3
sfx.say: I keep waiting for someone to tell me whether that was the right call.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.idle_before.4
sfx.say: The flat's exactly the same. That's the strange bit.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.idle_before.5
sfx.say: I could ring somebody. And say what.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.idle_before.6
sfx.say: I've had a shower and I can still smell that house.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.idle_before.7
sfx.say: Shoes are ruined. Not mine, that. That's the good version.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.idle_before.8
sfx.say: Sit down, Tony. That's the whole plan. That's the entire plan.

sfx._comment: SM-030 — THE CALL. Every line is the owner’s. The pause after "Special one." is the whole call. Booski hangs up first, mid-air, without waiting. He does not say goodbye. Do not add one.
sfx.name: vo.call.booski.special_meeting.1
sfx.say: Prospect.

sfx.name: vo.call.booski.special_meeting.tony.1
sfx.say: What's up?

sfx.name: vo.call.booski.special_meeting.2
sfx.say: We're having a meeting tonight.

sfx.name: vo.call.booski.special_meeting.tony.2
sfx.say: Yeah?

sfx.name: vo.call.booski.special_meeting.3
sfx.say: Yeah. Special one.

sfx.name: vo.call.booski.special_meeting.tony.3
sfx.say: What kinda special?

sfx.name: vo.call.booski.special_meeting.4
sfx.say: You'll find out.

sfx.name: vo.call.booski.special_meeting.tony.4
sfx.say: Where?

sfx.name: vo.call.booski.special_meeting.5
sfx.say: Don't worry about that. We're sending some guys over to pick you up.

sfx.name: vo.call.booski.special_meeting.tony.5
sfx.say: Who?

sfx.name: vo.call.booski.special_meeting.6
sfx.say: Seff, Lag and Numbskull. They'll be there soon.

sfx.name: vo.call.booski.special_meeting.tony.6
sfx.say: Booski, what is this?

sfx.name: vo.call.booski.special_meeting.7
sfx.say: It's a meeting, Prospect. Put on something decent.

sfx._comment: SM-040 — The dead line.
sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.dead_line.1
sfx.say: …Right.

sfx._comment: SM-050 — Ringing Booski back. Player-initiated. It must go nowhere: it rings, and rings, and does not go to voicemail and does not get answered. Then one of these.
sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.call_back.1
sfx.say: He's not picking up. He literally just put the phone down.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.call_back.2
sfx.say: It's not even ringing out. It's just ringing.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.call_back.3
sfx.say: Fine. Fine.

sfx._comment: SM-060 — Idle, after the call. Replaces SM-010 on the same timer. Same flat, different man.
sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.idle_after.1
sfx.say: 'Special one.'

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.idle_after.2
sfx.say: He's never once told me where. Not once. In a year.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.idle_after.3
sfx.say: Seff, Lag and Numbskull. That's three.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.idle_after.4
sfx.say: Three of them. To collect one bloke.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.idle_after.5
sfx.say: Put on something decent. Right. Decent.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.idle_after.6
sfx.say: It's a meeting. He said it's a meeting.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.idle_after.7
sfx.say: I'm reading into it. I'm aware I'm reading into it.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.idle_after.8
sfx.say: I'd feel better if he'd shouted at me.

sfx._comment: SM-070 — Getting ready. Chore beats in the flat’s existing frame. The last one is him talking himself down and failing. He is the only person in this scene permitted to say anything reassuring to Tony, and it has to fail.
sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.getting_ready.1
sfx.say: What do you wear to a special one.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.getting_ready.2
sfx.say: That'll do. That's decent.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.getting_ready.3
sfx.say: That's the jacket, then. That's the one I've picked.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.getting_ready.4
sfx.say: It's a meeting. It's a meeting and I've been asked to it.

sfx._comment: SM-080 — Door refusals while he waits. If the player tries to leave before the car arrives.
sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.door_refusal.1
sfx.say: No. He said they're coming here. I'm not walking out on that.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.door_refusal.2
sfx.say: They're picking me up. If I'm not in when they get here, that's on me.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.door_refusal.3
sfx.say: I don't know where it is. That's rather the point.

sfx._comment: SM-090 — Headlights. Headlights swing across the ceiling and stop. The engine keeps running. Nobody knocks. It is still running when he gets outside.
sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.headlights.1
sfx.say: That's them, then.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.headlights.2
sfx.say: They're early. …Or I'm late. One of the two.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.headlights.3
sfx.say: Right. Down we go.

sfx._comment: SM-100 — The car arrives. Lag gets out of the FRONT and stands with the door open behind him, on his phone. Numbskull gets out of the back, unhurried, and walks round. Seff stays at the wheel and leans across.
sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.seff.arrival.1
sfx.say: Tony. Hey.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.seff.arrival.2
sfx.say: You look alright. That's a good jacket.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.lag.arrival.1
sfx.say: Nice out.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.seff.arrival.3
sfx.say: Quick thing before we go — no. Forget it. Later.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.lag.arrival.2
sfx.say: Forty minutes, roughly. There's no signal past the reservoir. I checked.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.numbskull.arrival.1
sfx.say: Front.

sfx._comment: SM-120 — I'll sit in the back..
sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.back_seat.1
sfx.say: I'll sit in the back.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.numbskull.back_seat.1
sfx.say: Nah. Take the front.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.back_seat.2
sfx.say: I'm good back there.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.numbskull.back_seat.2
sfx.say: Prospect. Sit up front.

sfx._comment: SM-130 — Why do I have to sit up front?.
sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.why_front.1
sfx.say: Why do I have to sit up front?

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.seff.why_front.1
sfx.say: Because we're asking you to sit up front.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.why_front.2
sfx.say: That's not really an answer.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.lag.why_front.1
sfx.say: It's the answer you're getting.

sfx._comment: SM-140 — Is Lag not sitting there?.
sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.lag_seat.1
sfx.say: Is Lag not sitting there?

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.lag.lag_seat.1
sfx.say: I was.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.lag.lag_seat.2
sfx.say: It's free now.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.lag_seat.2
sfx.say: Right.

sfx._comment: SM-150 — Am I in trouble?. The direct question. He is allowed to ask it. He is not allowed to get an answer. Seff genuinely considers it and thinks he answered.
sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.in_trouble.1
sfx.say: Am I in trouble?

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.seff.in_trouble.1
sfx.say: With who?

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.in_trouble.2
sfx.say: I don't know. That's why I asked.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.seff.in_trouble.2
sfx.say: Well. There you go.

sfx._comment: SM-160 — Can I just follow you in my own car?.
sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.own_car.1
sfx.say: Can I just follow you in my own car?

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.lag.own_car.1
sfx.say: You'd never find it.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.own_car.2
sfx.say: You could give me the address.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.lag.own_car.2
sfx.say: There isn't one.

sfx._comment: SM-170 — [Say nothing.]. Nobody fills the silence for him. Numbskull keeps holding the door. Lag keeps scrolling. Seff watches the road ahead through the windscreen. The engine idles. Hold this longer than is comfortable.
sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.seff.say_nothing.1
sfx.say: We're alright for time.

sfx._comment: SM-180 — Final resistance. The hardest line anybody says in the scene, and it is still not aggressive. He is embarrassed for Tony. Play it that way.
sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.dont_like.1
sfx.say: I really don't like this.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.numbskull.dont_like.1
sfx.say: You're making it weird.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.numbskull.dont_like.2
sfx.say: Get in.

sfx._comment: SM-190 — The seat. Numbskull closes the door for him — a courtesy, done properly, with two hands — then walks around the back of the car and gets in behind him. Lag behind Seff. Seff adjusts the rear-view mirror and in doing so ends up looking at Tony. He does not hold it. The central locking goes and nobody remarks on it. Do not have anybody remark on it.
sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.seat.1
sfx.say: All right.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.seff.seat.1
sfx.say: Belt.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.seat.2
sfx.say: Right.

sfx._comment: SM-210 — The sandwich. From directly behind Tony’s head, the sound of a paper bag.
sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.numbskull.sandwich.1
sfx.say: You want half of this?

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.sandwich.opt1
sfx.say: No. Thanks.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.sandwich.opt2
sfx.say: …Yeah. Go on.

sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.tony.sandwich.opt3
sfx.say: What is it?

sfx._comment: SM-211 — No, thanks.
sfx.name: vo.specialmeeting.numbskull.sandwich_no.1
sfx.say: It's good.

sfx._comment: SM-212 — Go on, then. Now Tony is eating a sandwich a man in the seat behind him handed him, and there is nothing wrong with that, and he cannot stop thinking about it.
