sfx.say: Inside, six people do one job. Outside, six targets move as one.

sfx.name: heist.snow_rules
sfx.say: No civilians. No souvenirs. Nobody leaves a person to save a bag.

sfx.name: heist.rippin_route
sfx.say: Route Green behaves at lunch. Today every light is going to discover a personality.

sfx.name: heist.shubes_case
sfx.say: The blue case is organized. Your hands are not part of the organization.

sfx.name: heist.death_bags
sfx.say: Lou bought bigger bags. Apparently confidence has handles.

sfx.name: heist.numb_alarm
sfx.say: I am nowhere near the alarms. This is me saying it before anybody asks.

sfx.name: heist.prospect_ready
sfx.say: Armor is on. Magazines are full. I heard the plan.

sfx.name: heist.rippin_two_lights
sfx.say: Two lights.

sfx.name: heist.snow_time
sfx.say: Time.

sfx.name: heist.shubes_loop
sfx.say: Exterior loop is live. It will remain useful until somebody looks out a window.

sfx.name: heist.death_breathe
sfx.say: Breathe now. It costs more in there.

sfx.name: heist.guard_warning
sfx.say: Stop right there. Hands where I can see them.

sfx.name: heist.snow_guard
sfx.say: Prospect, visible guard. Put him on the floor.

sfx.name: heist.prospect_counterstrike
sfx.say: Good thing about all that Counter-Strike I've been playing.

sfx.name: heist.snow_scoreboard
sfx.say: Save the scoreboard. Watch the lobby.

sfx.name: heist.death_floor
sfx.say: Hands clear. Eyes down. Nobody here needs to be brave.

sfx.name: heist.civilian_please
sfx.say: Nobody move. Please, just do what they say.

sfx.name: heist.numb_manager
sfx.say: Manager is mine. Teller line is listening.

sfx.name: heist.manager_delay
sfx.say: You do not know the delay. That door will not care who is holding the gun.

sfx.name: heist.shubes_answer
sfx.say: He does not have to know it. I know the panel.

sfx.name: heist.shubes_vault
sfx.say: Panel first. Time-delay second. Nobody touches the leads.

sfx.name: heist.snow_clock
sfx.say: Four minutes became two. Fill the bags we have and leave the rest.

sfx.name: heist.snow_insured
sfx.say: We came for insured paper, not uninsured people. Keep it clean.

sfx.name: heist.numb_signal
sfx.say: Foot switch. I stopped the teller. I did not stop what she already sent.

sfx.name: heist.rippin_street
sfx.say: Blue lights on both ends. Route Green is turning brown.

sfx.name: heist.snow_exit_alarm
sfx.say: The sirens are the clock now. Bags, tools, people. Move.

sfx.name: heist.snow_contact
sfx.say: Planters first. Prospect, right side!

sfx.name: heist.death_suppress
sfx.say: Intersection is occupied. I am correcting it.

sfx.name: heist.rippin_van
sfx.say: Van is boxed. Give me five seconds and a miracle with keys.

sfx.name: heist.rippin_hit
sfx.say: That is my leg. Route Green is officially cancelled.

sfx.name: heist.snow_fallback
sfx.say: Mercer garage. Pairs. Leave the van and keep Rippin between us.

sfx.name: heist.numb_bag
sfx.say: Bag is down. Rippin is not. Make the choice fast.

sfx.name: heist.snow_leave_it
sfx.say: Do not trade a person for paper.

sfx.name: heist.shubes_garage
sfx.say: Sedan is live. The ignition was never the difficult system.

sfx.name: heist.death_load
sfx.say: Cover me. Bags are heavier when everybody is shooting at the handles.

sfx.name: heist.rippin_drive
sfx.say: Prospect drives. Left out, wrong way on purpose, then the warehouse lights.

sfx.name: heist.rippin_market_left
sfx.say: Left at the warehouse. Hold it through Market, then right at the glass tower.

sfx.name: heist.snow_roadblock
sfx.say: Roadblock. Center gap. Do not argue with the cruisers.

sfx.name: heist.rippin_canal
sfx.say: Canal road next. Narrow means they cannot put three cars beside us.

sfx.name: heist.shubes_swap
sfx.say: Cash first, coats second, weapons in the lined bin. In that order.

sfx.name: heist.death_swap_bags
sfx.say: Eight bags moved. Nobody leaves a handle in the dirty car.

sfx.name: heist.rippin_swap_aid
sfx.say: Tie it above the tear. I can complain in the clean car.

sfx.name: heist.snow_return
sfx.say: Nobody celebrates until I count six people and every bag in this room.

sfx.name: heist.rippin_aid
sfx.say: The van had one job and chose performance art. Wrap the leg tighter.

sfx.name: heist.shubes_defend
sfx.say: The vault opened on schedule. The alarm was a separate and inferior system.

sfx.name: heist.shubes_signature_cleanup
sfx.say: Hey guys, what’s going on?
sfx.direction: Pleasant, deadpan, and entirely untroubled during mission cleanup. He sounds as though he has just joined an ordinary group chat.

sfx.name: heist.death_ammo
sfx.say: Ammunition accounted for. Everybody else is somebody else’s paperwork.

sfx.name: heist.numb_home
sfx.say: I saw the tracker late. I saw it. We are still all standing here.

sfx.name: heist.snow_good
sfx.say: You moved when I said move. You covered people before money. Lou will hear that.

sfx.name: heist.lou_call
sfx.say: Everybody breathing? Good. Clean up. Bada Bing, seven. Wear something worth remembering.

sfx.name: heist.prospect_home
sfx.say: We got out. Everybody came home.

sfx.name: heist.snow_mask_call
sfx.say: Two blocks. Masks on now, while there is nobody outside to watch us do it.

sfx.name: heist.prospect_mask_on
sfx.say: Mask is down. I can see fine.

sfx.name: heist.numb_van_count
sfx.say: Four minutes on the floor, one on the vault, one to walk out. That is the whole plan.

sfx.name: heist.numb_lobby_order
sfx.say: Everybody on the floor. Face down, hands out. This takes four minutes and then we are gone.

sfx.name: heist.snow_lobby_open
sfx.say: The room is yours, Prospect. Get them flat and keep them flat.

sfx.name: heist.snow_control_slipping
sfx.say: Half your room is up on its knees again. Fix it before I have to.

sfx.name: heist.numb_lobby_held
sfx.say: Lobby is tied off. Nobody in here is going anywhere on their own.

sfx.name: heist.numb_alarm_reached
sfx.say: Somebody got a hand to a switch. Whatever clock you thought you had, it is shorter.

sfx.name: heist.death_runner
sfx.say: Runner. West side, and he is four seconds from the street.

sfx.name: heist.snow_no_souvenirs
sfx.say: That is a man’s wallet in your hand. Put it down, or carry it into Lou’s office and explain it.

sfx.name: heist.snow_casualty
sfx.say: That was a customer. That is the one thing we do not do.

sfx.name: heist.snow_casualty_alt
sfx.say: He was queuing. He had a paying-in book in his hand.

sfx.name: heist.snow_casualty_alt_two
sfx.say: Nobody in here owns the money. Aim at the ones who are paid to stop us.

sfx.name: heist.snow_casualty_two
sfx.say: That is two. Two is not an accident. Two is how you are doing this.

sfx.name: heist.snow_casualty_two_alt
sfx.say: Second one. I am going to have to say who that was, out loud, to Lou.

sfx.name: heist.snow_casualty_two_alt_two
sfx.say: Put it down. Every one of these costs us a year we have not got.

sfx.name: heist.snow_casualty_three
sfx.say: Three. You are not robbing this bank any more. You are clearing it.

sfx.name: heist.snow_casualty_three_alt
sfx.say: Three of them. Whatever this is, it stopped being the plan two ago.

sfx.name: heist.snow_casualty_three_alt_two
sfx.say: I am asking once more, and then I stop asking. Off the customers.

sfx.name: heist.snow_committed
sfx.say: All right. We are committed now. Nobody in this room gets to describe us. Finish it, and be quick, because the ones at the back have started counting doors.

sfx.name: heist.snow_sweep
sfx.say: Anyone still moving is a statement to a detective. Keep working.

sfx.name: heist.snow_sweep_two
sfx.say: Check behind the desks. The quiet ones are the ones who remember faces.

sfx.name: heist.snow_sweep_three
sfx.say: We do not get to stop halfway through this. Not now.

sfx.name: heist.snow_sweep_clear
sfx.say: Room is quiet. Take the bags. We never talk about this one again.

sfx.name: heist.snow_friendly_fire
sfx.say: Muzzle. Off me. Now.

sfx.name: heist.snow_friendly_fire_two
sfx.say: That is twice you have put that barrel across me. Pick a direction.

sfx.name: heist.death_friendly_fire
sfx.say: Hey. I am on your side and I am standing right here.

sfx.name: heist.prospect_reassure_one
sfx.say: Nobody here wants your money. It is the bank’s, it is insured, and it is not worth your life.

sfx.name: heist.prospect_reassure_two
sfx.say: Look at me. Do what I say and you go home to whoever is waiting on you.

sfx.name: heist.prospect_order_down
sfx.say: DOWN. On the floor, face down, hands out. Nobody makes me say it twice.

sfx.name: heist.prospect_order_two
sfx.say: On the floor. All the way down, and stay there.

sfx.name: heist.prospect_order_three
sfx.say: Flat. Palms open, arms out. Nobody has to look at anybody.

sfx.name: heist.prospect_order_four
sfx.say: You are already doing fine. Keep doing it lying down.

sfx.name: heist.prospect_order_five
sfx.say: Knees, then chest, then hands. In that order and no faster.

sfx.name: heist.prospect_demand
sfx.say: Wallet. Watch. On the tile in front of you.

sfx.name: heist.prospect_demand_two
sfx.say: Whatever is in the coat. Out, on the floor, slide it.

sfx.name: heist.prospect_demand_three
sfx.say: Pockets. Both of them. Do not make me go in there.

sfx.name: heist.prospect_tie
sfx.say: Hands behind your back. This is so I can stop watching you.

sfx.name: heist.prospect_tie_two
sfx.say: Wrists together. It is plastic, it comes off with scissors.

sfx.name: heist.prospect_tie_three
sfx.say: Do not pull against it. Pulling is the only way it hurts.

sfx.name: heist.prospect_tie_four
sfx.say: That is you finished. Nothing else happens to you today.

sfx.name: heist.prospect_tie_five
sfx.say: Behind your back. Breathe out. There — done.

sfx.name: heist.hostage_plead_one
sfx.say: Please. Please don’t shoot.

sfx.name: heist.hostage_plead_two
sfx.say: I’m not doing anything. I’m not doing anything.

sfx.name: heist.hostage_plead_three
sfx.say: Okay. Okay. It’s okay, I’m looking at the floor.

sfx.name: heist.hostage_plead_four
sfx.say: I have a daughter. I have a daughter at home.

sfx.name: heist.hostage_plead_five
sfx.say: Nobody’s moving. Look — nobody in here is moving.

sfx.name: heist.hostage_plead_teller
sfx.say: There’s nothing back here. There’s nothing in my drawer.

sfx.name: heist.hostage_plead_teller_two
sfx.say: The drawers are on a timer. I couldn’t open them if you made me.

sfx.name: heist.hostage_plead_teller_three
sfx.say: I do this for eleven dollars an hour. Please point that somewhere else.

sfx.name: heist.hostage_reassured_one
sfx.say: It isn’t mine. None of it is mine. Take it.

sfx.name: heist.hostage_reassured_two
sfx.say: Thank you. Thank you. I’m staying right here.

sfx.name: heist.hostage_reassured_three
sfx.say: Alright. Alright. I believe you.

sfx.name: heist.hostage_reassured_four
sfx.say: I’m not going to be a problem. I promise I’m not going to be a problem.

sfx.name: heist.hostage_reassured_hard
sfx.say: Then take it and go. Please just take it and go.

sfx.name: heist.hostage_reassured_hard_two
sfx.say: Don’t tell me it’s fine. Nothing about this is fine.

sfx.name: heist.hostage_reassured_hard_three
sfx.say: Just say how long. Somebody tell me how long.

sfx.name: heist.hostage_hands_over
sfx.say: That’s all of it. That’s everything I have on me.

sfx.name: heist.hostage_hands_over_two
sfx.say: Take the watch too. It was a gift, but take it.

sfx.name: heist.hostage_hands_over_three
sfx.say: There. There, it’s yours, it’s all yours.

sfx.name: heist.hostage_refuses
sfx.say: I don’t have anything. I came in to pay a bill.

sfx.name: heist.hostage_refuses_two
sfx.say: You’ve had it. There is nothing else in these pockets.

sfx.name: heist.hostage_refuses_three
sfx.say: I’m overdrawn. That’s why I’m standing in a bank on a Thursday.

sfx.name: heist.hostage_tied
sfx.say: It’s too tight. It’s too tight.

sfx.name: heist.hostage_tied_two
sfx.say: Okay. Okay, I’m not fighting it.

sfx.name: heist.hostage_tied_three
sfx.say: My hands are going numb. Are they meant to go numb?

sfx.name: heist.hostage_caught
sfx.say: I wasn’t reaching for anything. I wasn’t.

sfx.name: heist.hostage_caught_two
sfx.say: It’s a phone. It’s only a phone, I’m putting it down.

sfx.name: heist.hostage_witness
sfx.say: You shot him. Oh God, you shot him.

sfx.name: heist.hostage_witness_two
sfx.say: He’s not moving. Somebody — he isn’t moving.

sfx.name: heist.manager_second
sfx.say: The timer does not care that you are in a hurry. Neither do I.

sfx.name: heist.rippin_tower_right
sfx.say: Glass tower on the corner. Right there, and do not slow down for the light.

sfx.name: heist.rippin_swap_ahead
sfx.say: Canal road. Yard gate on your left, four hundred metres. Lights off before you turn in.

sfx.name: heist.snow_lost_them
sfx.say: Nothing behind us. Nothing above us. We are a grey car on a service road.

sfx.name: heist.rippin_pursuit_close
sfx.say: He is on the bumper. Do not brake for him, he will just get braver.

sfx.name: heist.snow_pursuit_stopped
sfx.say: Why are we stationary? A parked car is a surrender. Move it.

sfx.name: heist.rippin_pursuit_ram
sfx.say: That was on purpose! He is trying to put us into a wall — go, go, do not let him line it up again.

sfx.name: heist.lou_radio_open
sfx.say: Prospect. You are on my clock now. Do what Snow says and come back with everybody you left with.

sfx.name: heist.lou_radio_lobby
sfx.say: Those people on the floor are the bank’s problem, not yours. Do not make them yours.

sfx.name: heist.lou_radio_vault
sfx.say: Eight bags on that trolley. Eight is the number. I do not want to hear a seven.

sfx.name: heist.lou_radio_street
sfx.say: I can hear the sirens from my office. Get off that street.

sfx.name: heist.lou_debrief_open
sfx.say: Sit down, all of you. I only ever ask two things after a day like this.

sfx.name: heist.lou_debrief_people_clean
sfx.say: First one. Everybody who walked into that lobby walked back out of it. That is the whole reason I use you and not somebody cheaper.

sfx.name: heist.lou_debrief_people_dirty
sfx.say: First one, and you already know the answer. Somebody who came in to cash a cheque did not walk back out. That follows this family around for years.

sfx.name: heist.lou_debrief_money_full
sfx.say: Second one. All eight bags, insured paper, nothing on anybody’s person. That is the number I wanted and that is the number I got.

sfx.name: heist.lou_debrief_money_short
sfx.say: Second one. You left money on Mercer Street. It is insured, so nobody cries — but I asked for eight and I am counting less than eight.

sfx.name: heist.lou_debrief_souvenirs
sfx.say: And there is money in that bag that came out of a man’s coat. Take it off the table. We are not muggers, and it is coming out of your end.

sfx.name: heist.lou_debrief_verdict_good
sfx.say: Then it was a good day. Nobody hurt, everything counted, and tomorrow it is a paragraph nobody reads. Well done, kid.

sfx.name: heist.lou_debrief_verdict_bad
sfx.say: So it was not a good day. You are still standing here, which is something. Do not let anybody tell you it was clean.

sfx.name: heist.lou_prospect_verdict
sfx.say: You came home with the crew and you came home with the money. Whatever they decide about you later, that is on the record.

sfx.name: heist.snow_debrief_open
sfx.say: Sit down, all of you. We do this the same way every time.

sfx.name: heist.snow_debrief_people
sfx.say: People first. I count six of us. Now somebody tell me the other number.

sfx.name: heist.snow_debrief_money
sfx.say: Then the money. What went in the car, and what we left on Mercer.

sfx.name: heist.snow_debrief_clean
sfx.say: Nothing on the news tonight but a number. That is what a good day looks like.

sfx.name: heist.snow_debrief_ugly
sfx.say: That was not a job. That was a mess we walked out of. Lou hears it from me first.

sfx.name: heist.numb_debrief_ledger
sfx.say: Eight bags came off the trolleys. Here is what actually got home.

sfx.name: heist.death_debrief_count
sfx.say: Count it twice. I am not doing this again on Lou’s carpet.

sfx.name: heist.prospect_debrief
sfx.say: First one. I moved when Snow said move and I did not make anything worse.

sfx.name: vo.bing.ambient.01
sfx.say: You hear something happened with the butcher union?

sfx.name: vo.bing.ambient.02
sfx.say: I don’t talk business near the coat check.

sfx.name: vo.bing.ambient.03
sfx.say: Four hundred on a duck. A duck. In this economy.

sfx.name: vo.bing.ambient.04
sfx.say: He says it’s a franchise. It’s a van.

sfx.name: vo.bing.ambient.05
sfx.say: You want a drink or you want the seat? Both is fine. Neither isn’t.

sfx.name: vo.bing.ambient.06
sfx.say: They stopped doing the Sunday thing. Nobody said why.

sfx.name: vo.bing.ambient.07
sfx.say: One more hand and I’m going home. I mean it this time.

sfx.name: vo.bing.ambient.08
sfx.say: That’s the prospect. Don’t look at him, you’ll set him off.

sfx.name: vo.bing.ambient.09
sfx.say: Wednesday. Seven. Everybody keeps saying it like I’ve got a diary.

sfx.name: vo.bing.bartender.capacity
sfx.say: Finish one of those first. I am not a shelf.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.ape.aside.line.rqb5su
sfx.say: If it comes off, something behind it has to hold the weight instead. Nobody wants that. I do not want that.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.ape.asideMore.line.9a3t0p
sfx.say: So I keep it on, I have a nice time, and everybody goes home. It is a system and it works.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.ape.open.tony.1ms948l
sfx.say: I’ll write that on my hand.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.ape.open.tony.kay3u1
sfx.say: Another time.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.ape.open.tony.qqlmup
sfx.say: Load-bearing how?

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.associate.no.line.xr8cgp
sfx.say: No. That’s not what that was. Come on.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.associate.open.line.1ub3l1a
sfx.say: Congratulations. You’ve discovered cards. Lou wants you.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.associate.open.tony.124286t
sfx.say: One more hand.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.associate.open.tony.16pgg7u
sfx.say: I’m going.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.aubbie.aside.line.yx6t7d
sfx.say: Two nights. There is a chair where I work that reclines, if you lean on it and agree not to call it a chair.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.aubbie.asideMore.line.cevhsx
sfx.say: My daughter has started describing me to her friends off a photograph. She holds it up. This one, she says. He is very busy.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.aubbie.more.line.gdwsve
sfx.say: Twelve hours, and then the telephone at midnight to ask how it is coming along. It is coming along exactly as it was at seven. It is coming along.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.aubbie.more.tony.1sbfst0
sfx.say: Get some sleep, Aubbie.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.aubbie.open.line.ojzmwc
sfx.say: Lou has me working on a big project. He wants it done yesterday. I am one man with one pair of hands — I am only human.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.aubbie.open.tony.12ju9v8
sfx.say: You look like you haven’t slept.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.aubbie.open.tony.8whbeq
sfx.say: Everything’s yesterday with Lou.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.aubbie.open.tony.kay3u1
sfx.say: Another time.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.bartender.joke.line.1uqigwu
sfx.say: Architecture. Take it up with the architect. He’s dead.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.bartender.lou-drink.line.17f403x
sfx.say: Coffee. Black, and he complains about it. Enjoy.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.bartender.open.line.1w2a01j
sfx.say: Lou’s in the back. He said don’t make him wait.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.bartender.open.line.k4a1l5
sfx.say: You’re done already? He must like you.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.bartender.open.tony.1573ecz
sfx.say: One for the road.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.bartender.open.tony.1d6a7tv
sfx.say: What’s good back there that isn’t going to kill me?

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.bartender.open.tony.1h534md
sfx.say: Later.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.bartender.open.tony.e38pik
sfx.say: Put it on Booski’s tab.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.bartender.open.tony.g8wg42
sfx.say: Anything I should know before I go back there?

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.bartender.open.tony.kay3u1
sfx.say: Another time.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.bartender.open.tony.poqixp
sfx.say: Then why’d you put a bar between me and his office?

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.bartender.order.tony.1un6u0s
sfx.say: Whatever Lou drinks.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.bartender.order.tony.ip1fej
sfx.say: Beer.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.bartender.order.tony.ti7t3r
sfx.say: Whiskey. Neat.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.bartender.order.tony.xa0av4
sfx.say: Club soda. I’m working.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.bartender.poured.line.1t39iem
sfx.say: This is the last one before he sees you. I mean that as a favour.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.bartender.poured.line.1tvet
sfx.say: On the house. Everything in here is on the house until Lou says otherwise.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.bartender.soda.line.kmxlpd
sfx.say: Club soda. There you go. Big night.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.bartender.tip.line.19crrv7
sfx.say: Somebody’s been sat in the lot twenty minutes. Engine off. Two of them. Not drinking, not leaving, not my business.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.booski.open.tony.1h2bls2
sfx.say: Later — errands.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.booski.open.tony.h4rucb
sfx.say: The house always pays you, Boosk.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.booski.open.tony.obkpk3
sfx.say: Good to see you too, Boosk.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.bouncer.annoyed.line.3lxppj
sfx.say: You drove through Jersey. In Jersey. To Jersey. Go in before I have to think about it.

sfx.name: vo.bing.full.bouncer.direct.line.14rmtxu
sfx.say: Everybody’s expected. Nobody’s expected. Go on.

sfx.name: vo.silvercase.lou.ape.reaction.silent
sfx.say: Nothing to say. Smart, for once.

sfx.name: vo.silvercase.lou.ape.reaction.lighting
sfx.say: …No. It does not depend on the lighting.

sfx.name: vo.silvercase.prayer.ape.onemoment
sfx.say: Lou believes every man should get one moment to understand why this is happening.

sfx.name: vo.silvercase.prayer.ape.line1
sfx.say: Great Beast of the dark timber, steady our hands and mark our trail.

sfx.name: vo.silvercase.prayer.ape.line2
sfx.say: Let the loyal walk beneath the silver branches.

sfx.name: vo.silvercase.prayer.ape.line3
sfx.say: Let thieves hear the footsteps before they see what’s coming.

sfx.name: vo.silvercase.prayer.ape.line4
sfx.say: When the forest closes behind us, let it leave no path for betrayal.

sfx.name: vo.silvercase.prayer.ape.line5
sfx.say: Silver above. Family below.

sfx.name: vo.silvercase.prayer.prospect.nofootprints
sfx.say: No footprints left.

sfx.name: vo.silvercase.chair.ape.amen
sfx.say: Prayer’s said. Now the amen.

sfx.name: vo.silvercase.chair.ape.together
sfx.say: Together, Prospect. You and me. On you.

sfx.name: vo.silvercase.chair.ape.anytime
sfx.say: He isn’t going to volunteer. Any time now.

sfx.name: vo.silvercase.chair.ape.onestory
sfx.say: Two of us, one story. That’s how the Family remembers it.

sfx.name: vo.silvercase.chair.ape.myround
sfx.say: Fine. My round.

sfx.name: vo.silvercase.chair.ape.myparttoo
sfx.say: Lou is going to hear it was mine. That’s twice now I did your part of this.

sfx.name: vo.silvercase.bathroom.ape.listen
sfx.say: Good. You do listen occasionally.

sfx.name: vo.silvercase.bathroom.ape.countedfour
sfx.say: You counted four. I saw you.

sfx.name: vo.silvercase.aftermath.ape.witness
sfx.say: Congratulations. You’ve been promoted to witness.

sfx.name: vo.silvercase.aftermath.ape.cleanup
sfx.say: Clean this up. All of it. And you were never here.

sfx.name: vo.silvercase.aftermath.winston.neverhere
sfx.say: Yes — yes sir. Never. I was never here.

sfx.name: vo.silvercase.aftermath.ape.ordont
sfx.say: …Or don’t.

sfx.name: vo.silvercase.aftermath.ape.yourround
sfx.say: Your call, your round. He’s standing right there.

sfx.name: vo.silvercase.aftermath.winston.please
sfx.say: Please — please, I’ll clean it, I’ll clean all of it —

sfx.name: vo.silvercase.aftermath.ape.nobodytoclean
sfx.say: Then there’s nobody to clean it. That’s a choice too.

sfx.name: vo.silvercase.aftermath.ape.wantitdoit
sfx.say: You don’t get to want it and not do it.

sfx.name: vo.silvercase.aftermath.ape.badideas
sfx.say: Always check the bathroom. That’s where bad ideas go to load themselves.

sfx.name: vo.silvercase.lou.prospect.choice.no
sfx.say: No.

sfx.name: vo.silvercase.lou.prospect.choice.absolutelynot
sfx.say: Absolutely not.

sfx.name: vo.silvercase.lou.prospect.choice.lighting
sfx.say: Depends on the lighting.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.lou.call-opening-1.1
sfx.say: Remember that little delivery flight?

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.prospect.call-opening-2.1
sfx.say: The jerky run?

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.lou.call-opening-3.1
sfx.say: This one’s heavier.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.hangar-reveal-1.1
sfx.say: There she is. The Enola Squatch.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.prospect.hangar-reveal-2.1
sfx.say: Why does she have purple stripes?

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.hangar-reveal-3.1
sfx.say: Morale.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.prospect.hangar-reveal-4.1
sfx.say: And the nose art?

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.hangar-reveal-5.1
sfx.say: More morale.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.preflight-arrival-1.1
sfx.say: There she is. Walk her with me before you get in — I am not signing for anything you did not look at.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.prospect.preflight-arrival-2.1
sfx.say: All of it?

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.preflight-arrival-3.1
sfx.say: All of it. Chocks, all four fans, the bay, the bomb, the tail.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.prospect.preflight-numbskull-1.1
sfx.say: Should you be standing under that?

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.numbskull.preflight-numbskull-2.1
sfx.say: Probably not.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.preflight-chocks-1.1
sfx.say: Chocks first. Two of them, and both of them come out, because I have seen what happens when it is one.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.preflight-props-1.1
sfx.say: Pull each one through by hand. Four engines means four times, not one time with feeling.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.prospect.preflight-props-all-1.1
sfx.say: All four turn.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.preflight-props-all-2.1
sfx.say: All four turning is the low bar. All four turning at the same time is the job.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.preflight-payload-look-1.1
sfx.say: That is the Fat Squatch. Do not lean on it, do not sit on it, do not put your coffee on it.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.numbskull.preflight-payload-tap-1.1
sfx.say: Hold the key down. You do not load one of these with a tap.
sfx.rerecordReason: the payload check moved from a strap tug to holding the arming key down in the 2026-08-20 flight pass; the indexed take teaches the wrong action. Found by tools/take-history.mjs on 2026-08-22, six days after the rewrite -- the same commit queued six other lines and missed this one

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.numbskull.preflight-bombbay-tap-1.1
sfx.say: Give it a proper look, not a glance. It is a panel, not a painting.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.preflight-surfaces-1.1
sfx.say: Move the elevator. If it moves, it is connected. If it does not, we have a much shorter evening.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.preflight-done-1.1
sfx.say: That is the walk. Nothing on this aeroplane is a surprise now, which is the most I have ever been able to say about it.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.preflight-done-2.1
sfx.say: Door is open, Prospect. Left seat. Yours is the one on the left as she sits, not as you look at her.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.preflight-board-1.1
sfx.say: Get in. Mind the ladder — it is the newest part of the aircraft and I do not trust it either.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.preflight-chocksStill-1.1
sfx.say: Chocks are still in. She will run up beautifully and go absolutely nowhere.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.preflight-restraints-1.1
sfx.say: Payload secure?

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.numbskull.preflight-restraints-2.1
sfx.say: Secure enough.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.preflight-loadSquatch-1.1
sfx.say: Load it. Slowly. It is the only one we brought.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.numbskull.preflight-loadSquatch-2.1
sfx.say: Bringing her under. Mind your feet.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.preflight-loadSquatch-3.1
sfx.say: Six thousand pounds of somebody’s idea.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.numbskull.preflight-loadSquatch-4.1
sfx.say: Shackles closed. Braces on. That is a bomb in a bomb bay.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.preflight-bombbay-1.1
sfx.say: Bomb-bay panel closed and pinned?

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.numbskull.preflight-bombbay-2.1
sfx.say: Closed. Pinned is a strong word.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.shubes.preflight-shubes-first-1.1
sfx.say: Hey guys, what’s going on?

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.preflight-shubes-first-2.1
sfx.say: How did you get on this aircraft?

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.shubes.preflight-shubes-first-3.1
sfx.say: You left the back open.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.preflight-shubes-first-4.1
sfx.say: That is not an answer, that is a confession.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.shubes.preflight-shubes-aboard-1.1
sfx.say: Hey guys, what’s going on?

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.preflight-shubes-aboard-2.1
sfx.say: You were at the back of the aeroplane forty seconds ago.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.shubes.preflight-shubes-aboard-3.1
sfx.say: Yeah. I came round the front. It’s more polite.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.preflight-shubes-aboard-4.1
sfx.say: He has used the door. I want that in the log.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.preflight-engineStart-1.1
sfx.say: Start sequence. One, then two.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.preflight-engineStart-2.1
sfx.say: Three and four are yours, Prospect. Don’t be gentle, be correct.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.preflight-sasole-chocksDone-1.1
sfx.say: Both of them. There are always two, and there is always a pilot who found out there were two.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.preflight-sasole-propOne-1.1
sfx.say: One. Nine more blades to go, Prospect.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.preflight-sasole-propTwo-1.1
sfx.say: Two. This is the part of aviation nobody puts on a poster.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.preflight-sasole-propThree-1.1
sfx.say: Three. If one of these bites you, we are down a bombardier and a hand.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.numbskull.preflight-sasole-propThree-2.1
sfx.say: I am the bombardier.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.preflight-sasole-propThree-3.1
sfx.say: Then be careful for both of us.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.preflight-sasole-propFour-1.1
sfx.say: Four. Every fan turns, nothing is seized, nobody is bleeding. Best preflight I have had all year.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.preflight-sasole-bayDone-1.1
sfx.say: Panel is on. That is not the same as the panel being right, but it is the half I can see.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.preflight-sasole-payloadDone-1.1
sfx.say: Straps are tight. That bomb goes out of this aeroplane once, on purpose, over somebody else.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.preflight-sasole-tailDone-1.1
sfx.say: Gun swings, ammunition is in it, and there is a Shubenator attached. Two of those I asked for.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.preflight-sasole-surfacesDone-1.1
sfx.say: Elevator moves the way the wheel tells it to. Small thing. Only matters every second we are up.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.preflight-sasole-boardNudge-1.1
sfx.say: Door is on the port side, behind the wing, with a ladder under it. Follow the marker, Prospect.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.preflight-sasole-boardNudge-2.1
sfx.say: I will be in the right seat pretending I did not have to say that.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.nightfall-hatch-1.1
sfx.say: Hatch closed. Bay closed. Nobody gets out of this aeroplane for the next four hours.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.shubes.nightfall-hatch-2.1
sfx.say: I would like it noted that I did not get in on purpose.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.nightfall-hatch-3.1
sfx.say: Noted. Denied.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.nightfall-wait-1.1
sfx.say: We do not go in daylight. We sit until the field goes dark and then we go.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.prospect.nightfall-wait-2.1
sfx.say: How long?

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.nightfall-wait-3.1
sfx.say: Long enough to think about it. Not long enough to change your mind.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.nightfall-lineup-1.1
sfx.say: There it is. Whispering Pines at night, one runway, no tower, nobody to tell us not to.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.nightfall-lineup-2.1
sfx.say: Lined up and holding, Captain. Lamps are out down both edges.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.nightfall-lineup-3.1
sfx.say: Then we are done waiting. Battery, fuel, four engines, Prospect. Wake her up.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.taxi-line-1.1
sfx.say: Runway’s yours. Long roll on this one — she’s carrying six thousand pounds of opinion.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.taxi-line-2.1
sfx.say: Straight line, Prospect. She will not forgive a wander.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.takeoff-rotate-1.1
sfx.say: Gear up. Complaints down. We’re officially committed.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.takeoff-airborne-1.1
sfx.say: Airborne, with the Fat Squatch still aboard. Nobody clap yet.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.climb-turn-east-1.1
sfx.say: Climb out on the runway heading, then come right onto zero-nine-zero. We’re going east tonight.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.climb-turn-west-1.1
sfx.say: Climb out on the runway heading, then come left onto two-seven-zero. We’re going west tonight.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.cruise-settle-1.1
sfx.say: Cruise. Lights out in a minute — let your eyes get used to it before we go dark.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.cruise-settle-2.1
sfx.say: Radio chatter’s ours to keep quiet from here.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.nav-left5-1.1
sfx.say: Come left five degrees.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.nav-right5-1.1
sfx.say: Come right five degrees.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.nav-wrongWay-1.1
sfx.say: Other left, Lindbergh.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.nav-goodLine-1.1
sfx.say: There. Hold that line.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.nav-nag-sasole-1.1
sfx.say: You planning on sightseeing? Heading zero-nine-zero.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.nav-nag-irish-1.1
sfx.say: Zero-nine-zero, Prospect. It is written down and everything.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.nav-nag-sasoleAgain-1.1
sfx.say: Bank her over. East. The city is not going to come to us.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.detect-corridor-1.1
sfx.say: Valley ahead. Get under the ridgeline and stay there — we go under their radar or we don’t go.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.detect-searching-1.1
sfx.say: Searchlight’s hunting, not looking right at us. Hold low.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.detect-located-1.1
sfx.say: They’ve got us. So much for quiet.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.detect-clear-1.1
sfx.say: Lost them. Nicely flown.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.shubes.defense-opening-1.1
sfx.say: Are those guys shooting at us?

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.defense-opening-2.1
sfx.say: No, Shubes. They’re applauding.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.shubes.defense-gunner-on-1.1
sfx.say: Rear gun’s hot. Say the word.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.shubes.defense-gunner-open-1.1
sfx.say: Word taken! Word absolutely taken!

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.defense-gunner-open-2.1
sfx.say: Hold her steady for him. He cannot hit anything if the whole aeroplane is the thing that is moving.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.defense-hit-1.1
sfx.say: That one found us. Report.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.shubes.defense-suppressed-1.1
sfx.say: I think I got one! I think! There was fire! Fire happened!

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.defense-engineStrain-1.1
sfx.say: Number three’s losing revs. She’s been asking for this the whole climb.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.defense-engineStrain-2.1
sfx.say: Heard it. Nurse it — we keep flying, we just fly lighter on that side.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.shubes.fighters-first-1.1
sfx.say: Something just went past the tail. Something fast and it was not ours.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.fighters-first-2.1
sfx.say: Single engine. He is climbing back up to have another look at us.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.fighters-first-3.1
sfx.say: Night fighters. They were always going to come. Everybody calls what they see, nobody guesses.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.shubes.fighters-down-1.1
sfx.say: He is going down! He is going DOWN!

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.fighters-down-2.1
sfx.say: Confirmed. One less of them.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.fighters-broke-1.1
sfx.say: They have turned back. We are past what their fuel will carry.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.fighters-broke-2.1
sfx.say: Then we are past the worst of it. Nobody relax.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.auto-on-1.1
sfx.say: Setting the gyro. She will hold this heading and this height and she will do nothing else.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.auto-on-2.1
sfx.say: Understand me. She will not get out of the way of anything. That part was you.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.auto-off-1.1
sfx.say: I have her. Hands on.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.auto-kicked-1.1
sfx.say: Gyro is off — she is going over! Prospect, seat, NOW!

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.shubes.gun-take-1.1
sfx.say: You want it? Take it. I am not proud and I am not accurate.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.gun-take-2.1
sfx.say: Prospect is on the tail gun. Nobody is flying this aeroplane but a box of gears, so be quick about it.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.shubes.gun-leave-1.1
sfx.say: It is warm. You are welcome.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.gun-dry-1.1
sfx.say: Belt is out. There is nothing else back there.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.shubes.gun-dry-2.1
sfx.say: There was a lot of it and now there is none of it.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.numbskull.bomb-targetInSight-1.1
sfx.say: Target coming into view.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.numbskull.bomb-cityInSight-1.1
sfx.say: That is a whole town down there. Streets and everything.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.bomb-cityInSight-2.1
sfx.say: Squatchbourg. Grid runs north–south, the tall part is the middle, and the middle is what we were given.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.prospect.bomb-cityInSight-3.1
sfx.say: It’s bigger than I thought.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.bomb-cityInSight-4.1
sfx.say: They always are. Fly the line.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.bomb-tenSeconds-1.1
sfx.say: Ten seconds.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.bomb-steady-1.1
sfx.say: Steady. Don’t chase it. Let the target come to you.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.numbskull.bomb-doorsFail-1.1
sfx.say: Doors aren’t opening.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.bomb-doorsFail-2.1
sfx.say: Why?

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.numbskull.bomb-doorsFail-3.1
sfx.say: I used the wrong bolts.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.bomb-manualReset-1.1
sfx.say: Then fix it manually and do it fast. Prospect, hold her level — level is the whole job right now.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.shubes.bomb-shubesInBay-1.1
sfx.say: Hey guys, what’s going on?

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.bomb-shubesInBay-2.1
sfx.say: GET OUT OF THERE!

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.bomb-shubesInBay-3.1
sfx.say: GET OUT OF THERE!

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.numbskull.bomb-shubesInBay-4.1
sfx.say: GET OUT OF THERE!

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.numbskull.bomb-doorsFixed-1.1
sfx.say: Doors are open! Doors are open, they were always going to open!

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.numbskull.bomb-releaseStuck-1.1
sfx.say: ...Nothing. Hang on.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.numbskull.bomb-releaseKick-1.1
sfx.say: Kicking the mount.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.numbskull.bomb-packageAway-1.1
sfx.say: Package away!

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.bomb-packageAway-2.1
sfx.say: That is a very generous definition of away.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.bomb-weightLoss-1.1
sfx.say: There she goes. Plane just lost six thousand pounds of bad intentions.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.bomb-breakTurn-1.1
sfx.say: Now TURN. Hard over, nose down, and do not stop turning until I tell you.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.bomb-breakTurn-2.1
sfx.say: Every second of that is distance, Prospect. Distance is the entire plan.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.shubes.bomb-falling-1.1
sfx.say: Is it supposed to make that noise?

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.numbskull.bomb-falling-2.1
sfx.say: That is the noise. That is the correct noise.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.bomb-falling-3.1
sfx.say: Then why is it getting worse.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.prospect.explosion-flash-1.1
sfx.say: I cannot see. I cannot see anything.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.explosion-flash-2.1
sfx.say: Nobody look at it. Fly the instruments. It comes back.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.explosion-shockwave-1.1
sfx.say: BRACE—

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.numbskull.explosion-shockwave-2.1
sfx.say: Something hit us! Something hit the whole aeroplane at once!

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.explosion-shockwave-3.1
sfx.say: That was the air. The air hit us.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.explosion-reaction-1.1
sfx.say: That seems excessive.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.explosion-reaction-2.1
sfx.say: That was the conservative setting.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.numbskull.explosion-column-1.1
sfx.say: It is still going up.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.explosion-column-2.1
sfx.say: It has been going up for fifteen seconds.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.numbskull.explosion-column-3.1
sfx.say: It is still going up.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.shubes.explosion-column-4.1
sfx.say: Is it going to stop?

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.explosion-column-5.1
sfx.say: Eventually.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.shubes.explosion-crater-1.1
sfx.say: Guys. Guys, where did it go?

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.numbskull.explosion-crater-2.1
sfx.say: The town?

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.shubes.explosion-crater-3.1
sfx.say: Yeah, the town.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.explosion-crater-4.1
sfx.say: There is a hole where the town was. A round one. You can see the far side of it from here.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.explosion-crater-5.1
sfx.say: That is what a crater is, Irish.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.prospect.explosion-crater-6.1
sfx.say: ...I said a line before that.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.explosion-crater-7.1
sfx.say: Nobody heard your line. Everybody is looking at the hole.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.escape-turn-1.1
sfx.say: Climb, bank, and don’t look at it. Looking at it doesn’t help.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.shubes.escape-gunnerDone-1.1
sfx.say: I think we’re out of bullets.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.escape-gunnerDone-2.1
sfx.say: You fired into the same truck for four minutes.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.fighters-sasoleTakesIt-1.1
sfx.say: Plane’s mine. You go shoot.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.fighters-sasoleTakesIt-2.1
sfx.say: Gyro has the heading, I have the yoke. Get in the tail, Prospect.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.shubes.fighters-sasoleTakesIt-3.1
sfx.say: There is someone already in here.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.fighters-sasoleTakesIt-4.1
sfx.say: Then budge up.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.escape-clear-1.1
sfx.say: Clean air. Keep climbing.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.emergency-overheat-1.1
sfx.say: Number three is running hot. Two-forty and climbing.
sfx.rerecordReason: the overheat moved to engine three with a temperature readout in the 2026-08-20 flight pass; the indexed take names a DIFFERENT ENGINE from the subtitle in a scene where the player acts on which one is hot. Found by tools/take-history.mjs on 2026-08-22

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.emergency-overheat-2.1
sfx.say: Ease her back. Bring the throttle down.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.emergency-throttleBack-1.1
sfx.say: Throttle, Prospect. All the way back to the stop and leave it there.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.emergency-stabilised-1.1
sfx.say: There you go. Hold it there until she cools off.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.numbskull.emergency-cooled-1.1
sfx.say: Two hundred and falling. She will live.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.emergency-cooled-2.1
sfx.say: Then we go home on four warm ones. Whispering Pines, straight in.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.emergency-shutdown-1.1
sfx.say: Shutting two down. She’ll fly on three, she just won’t enjoy it.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.emergency-pushedIt-1.1
sfx.say: That is not what I meant by hope.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.landing-line-1.1
sfx.say: Same field we left from. Try to remember which end has the hangar.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.landing-perfect-1.1
sfx.say: Maybe next time we let you fly something expensive.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.landing-hard-1.1
sfx.say: We dropped one package. Didn’t need to drop the aircraft.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.lou.arrival-lou-1.1
sfx.say: Did they get the package?

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.prospect.arrival-lou-2.1
sfx.say: They signed for it.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.lou.arrival-lou-3.1
sfx.say: Good. Put the plane back where you found it.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.bark-walkaroundIdle-1.1
sfx.say: Marker is on the next one, Prospect. It is not going to check itself.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.bark-walkaroundIdle-2.1
sfx.say: She is thirty-three metres across. Walking is most of the job.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.bark-walkaroundIdle-3.1
sfx.say: Sun is going down on us, Prospect. Keep moving.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.bark-walkaroundIdle-4.1
sfx.say: I have watched men stare at this aeroplane before. It never once fixed anything.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.bark-heavyBanked-1.1
sfx.say: Easy. She’s not the little plane. Ease it back.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.bark-heavyBanked-2.1
sfx.say: That bank angle is a request she is declining.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.bark-heavySlow-1.1
sfx.say: Nose down a hair. She climbs like it’s a personal insult when she’s this loaded.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.bark-heavySmooth-1.1
sfx.say: There. Small inputs. She rewards patience.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.shubes.bark-gunnerIdle-1.1
sfx.say: Rear gunner reporting no targets, several opinions.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.shubes.bark-gunnerIdle-2.1
sfx.say: Everything back here is fine. I am counting stars.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.shubes.bark-gunnerFiring-1.1
sfx.say: Eating a lot of tracer up here!

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.shubes.bark-gunnerFiring-2.1
sfx.say: This gun is louder than I expected and I expected a lot!

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.bark-lowFuel-1.1
sfx.say: Fuel’s getting opinions of its own. Keep it efficient.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.bark-terrainClose-1.1
sfx.say: Terrain. Terrain is a thing that wins arguments.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.bark-flakClose-1.1
sfx.say: That one was close enough to read the serial number off.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.bark-flakClose-2.1
sfx.say: Splinters. We are taking splinters down the side.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.numbskull.bark-flakClose-3.1
sfx.say: I felt that one in my teeth.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.shubes.bark-flakClose-4.1
sfx.say: The whole tail just moved and I was still attached to it!

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.shubes.bark-fighterCommitting-1.1
sfx.say: He is rolling in on us! High, coming down!

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.bark-fighterCommitting-2.1
sfx.say: One committing. He is inside a mile and he is not sightseeing.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.shubes.bark-fighterCommitting-3.1
sfx.say: I can see his exhaust. That is how close he is.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.shubes.bark-fighterAgain-1.1
sfx.say: He is back. He is BACK.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.bark-fighterAgain-2.1
sfx.say: Second pass. Do not give him a straight line to work with.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.bark-fighterAgain-3.1
sfx.say: Same one, coming round again. He is patient. I hate patient.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.shubes.bark-fighterNearMiss-1.1
sfx.say: That went past me! That went past ME!

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.bark-fighterNearMiss-2.1
sfx.say: Wide. He has not settled yet.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.numbskull.bark-fighterNearMiss-3.1
sfx.say: There is daylight in this aeroplane and it is night.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.numbskull.bark-fighterHitUs-1.1
sfx.say: We are hit! We are hit somewhere!

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.bark-fighterHitUs-2.1
sfx.say: Report. Somebody give me a number, not a noise.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.bark-fighterHitUs-3.1
sfx.say: He got some of us that time.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.shubes.bark-gunJam-1.1
sfx.say: It has stopped! It got too hot and it has STOPPED!

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.irish.bark-gunJam-2.1
sfx.say: Let it cool. Counting to three is not a personality flaw.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.bark-autoRefused-1.1
sfx.say: Not like this. Wings level, out of the buffet, and off the deck first.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.bark-autoRefused-2.1
sfx.say: The gyro is not a magician. Fly her level and ask me again.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.sasole.bark-gunRefused-1.1
sfx.say: Not on the ground, Prospect. There is nothing up there to shoot at.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.prospect.release-1.1
sfx.say: Fat Squatch away. God help whoever’s down there.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.prospect.release-2.1
sfx.say: Special delivery.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.prospect.release-3.1
sfx.say: That’s from Lou. And I’ll be sayin’ that in my sleep for the rest of me life.

sfx.name: vo.enolasquatch.prospect.release-4.1
sfx.say: Hope they’re hungry.
