sfx.name: vo.call.lou.golf.1
sfx.say: Silver Pines. Off Route Twenty-Three, past the quarry, second gate.

sfx.name: vo.call.lou.golf.2
sfx.say: Eight o'clock. Rippinflow and Eric are already complaining about the hour.

sfx.name: vo.call.lou.golf.3
sfx.say: Bring nothing. Wear something you can walk in.

sfx.name: vo.call.lou.golf.4
sfx.say: Three holes. Home by half ten. After that, your day starts.

sfx.name: vo.call.lou.golf.tony.1
sfx.say: Silver Pines. Second gate.

sfx.name: vo.call.lou.golf.tony.2
sfx.say: Eight o'clock.

sfx.name: vo.call.lou.golf.tony.3
sfx.say: Nothing but walking shoes.

sfx.name: vo.call.lou.golf.tony.4
sfx.say: Home by half ten. Understood.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.already_not
sfx.say: It is already not all love.
sfx.direction: Flat. Closing the exchange.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.and_yet
sfx.say: And yet these were the ones you brought.
sfx.direction: Gentle. He is not scoring a point, he is closing a door.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.birdie_on_the_first
sfx.say: Birdie on the first.
sfx.direction: Noting it for the card.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.boring_works
sfx.say: Middle of the green. Boring works.
sfx.direction: Approving.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.bushes_do_not_float
sfx.say: The bushes do not float.
sfx.direction: Correcting the record.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.cricket_rules
sfx.say: Cricket would have more rules and somehow less waiting.
sfx.direction: Mid-address. He does not stop what he is doing to say it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.did_not_survive
sfx.say: That sentence did not survive the putt.
sfx.direction: Immediate.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.do_not_do_that
sfx.say: Do not do that.
sfx.direction: Fast, and the only time Eric raises his voice all morning.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.exactly_that_much
sfx.say: Exactly that much.
sfx.direction: The quiet last line again. Let it sit.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.good_shot
sfx.say: Good shot.
sfx.direction: Plain and meant.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.he_does
sfx.say: He does.
sfx.direction: Confirming a fact, not agreeing with a joke.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.hes_been_hitting_it_all_morning
sfx.say: He has been hitting it all morning.
sfx.direction: Correcting the record, gently, as always.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.it_was_a_bunker
sfx.say: It was a bunker.
sfx.direction: Immovable.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.land_a_plane
sfx.say: He can land a plane. He can land an iron.
sfx.direction: Vouching for him, lightly.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.less_than_rippin_says
sfx.say: Less than Rippin says.
sfx.direction: Immediate.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.lou_said_you_noticed
sfx.say: Lou said you noticed the car.
sfx.direction: Making conversation, and passing on that Lou talks about him.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.middle_of_green
sfx.say: Middle of the green. Ignore the flag.
sfx.direction: To the Prospect, quietly. The single most useful sentence anybody says today.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.morning
sfx.say: Morning.
sfx.direction: Flat, warm, complete. He has already said everything he needs to.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.needed_the_rest
sfx.say: Needed the rest of the putt.
sfx.direction: Helpfully unhelpful.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.neither_was_your_tee_shot
sfx.say: Neither was your tee shot.
sfx.direction: The kill.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.nobody_wants_that
sfx.say: Nobody wants that.
sfx.direction: Immediate.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.not_what_i_said
sfx.say: That is not what I said.
sfx.direction: Patient.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.on_the_green
sfx.say: On the green.
sfx.direction: A fact.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.one_hundred_sixty_seven
sfx.say: He is putting from one hundred and sixty-seven yards.
sfx.direction: Stating it for the record, and for Rippin.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.only_if_first_goes_well
sfx.say: The second one is only fun if the first one goes well.
sfx.direction: Levelling it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.open_the_face
sfx.say: Open the face. Hit behind the ball.
sfx.direction: Actual instruction. It actually works.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.par
sfx.say: Par.
sfx.direction: A fact worth stating.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.par_five
sfx.say: Par five.
sfx.direction: Precise.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.roll_the_ball
sfx.say: Do not hit the hole. Roll the ball to the hole.
sfx.direction: Teaching, gently.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.selected_driver
sfx.say: You have selected a driver.
sfx.direction: Perfectly level. This is how Eric roasts people.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.short_grass
sfx.say: Short grass. That is the whole job off a tee.
sfx.direction: Plain approval. Eric does not gild anything.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.take_your_time
sfx.say: Take your time.
sfx.direction: Kind.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.that_does_happen
sfx.say: That does happen.
sfx.direction: Flatly confirming it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.that_is_different
sfx.say: That is different.
sfx.direction: Into the silence, after it has gone on slightly too long. He is telling the Prospect what just happened, because Lou never will.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.that_matters
sfx.say: That matters.
sfx.direction: Quiet and completely sincere.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.that_went_in
sfx.say: That went in.
sfx.direction: Quietly astonished, which for Eric is a shout.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.that_will_play
sfx.say: That will play.
sfx.direction: The highest praise Eric gives.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.thats_a_lot_of_club
sfx.say: That is a lot of club for a hundred and sixty-seven yards.
sfx.direction: Observing, not stopping him.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.useful_clarification
sfx.say: Useful clarification.
sfx.direction: Dry.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.wanted_bunker
sfx.say: You wanted the bunker?
sfx.direction: Sincere curiosity, which is worse.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.we_are_standing_here
sfx.say: We are standing here.
sfx.direction: Reasonable.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.yes
sfx.say: Yes.
sfx.direction: Conceding nothing at all.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.yes_2
sfx.say: Yes.
sfx.direction: Watching it go.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.you_have_a_shot
sfx.say: You have a shot.
sfx.direction: Encouraging and technically true.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.you_have_clubs
sfx.say: Those are clubs. Somebody paid a lot for them and it wasn’t you.
sfx.direction: The quiet last line. Do not push it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.eric.you_watched_it
sfx.say: You watched it happen.
sfx.direction: Reasonable.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.advice_for_both
sfx.say: That advice is for both of you.
sfx.direction: Without looking up from the card.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.after_that_the_room
sfx.say: After that, the room. Everybody’s there.
sfx.direction: He does not elaborate and does not intend to.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.aiming_there
sfx.say: He was aiming there.
sfx.direction: Quiet defence. Rare and worth noticing.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.also_gave_you_an_iron
sfx.say: I also gave you an iron.
sfx.direction: Unhurried. He has had this answer the whole time.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.becomes_work
sfx.say: It’s golf. It becomes work around the second bad shot.
sfx.direction: Dry. He is not joking and it is still funny.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.before_he_changes_his_mind
sfx.say: Pick up the ball before he changes his mind.
sfx.direction: Warm. As close to proud as he gets in public.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.cars_do_that
sfx.say: Cars do that. People miss it.
sfx.direction: Closing it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.closer_than_yours
sfx.say: It’s closer than yours.
sfx.direction: Walking away as he says it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.conversation_not_complaint
sfx.say: That is why this is a conversation and not a complaint.
sfx.direction: The rule of the whole family, stated once.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.criminal_pays_better
sfx.say: No. Criminal pays better.
sfx.direction: Absolutely deadpan. The best joke in the scene.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.didnt_promise_to_defend
sfx.say: We invited him. We didn’t promise to defend him.
sfx.direction: The joke and the reassurance in the same sentence.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.do_not_listen_to_him
sfx.say: Do not listen to him.
sfx.direction: Half-hearted.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.do_that_again_you_walk
sfx.say: Do that again and you walk.
sfx.direction: Not shouted. Considerably worse than shouted.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.dont_have_to_fill_it
sfx.say: You don’t have to fill every quiet minute. That’s one of the reasons you’re here.
sfx.direction: The reward for saying nothing. Deliver it as information, not as praise.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.driver_time
sfx.say: Driver time.
sfx.direction: To the Prospect, directly, for the first time all morning. He looks at him when he says it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.earned_invitation
sfx.say: You earned the invitation. Morning’s still up for debate.
sfx.direction: The first half is real and he moves past it fast.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.enough_to_remember
sfx.say: Enough to remember.
sfx.direction: Closing the card.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.everybody_gets_in_a_room
sfx.say: Everybody gets in a room and talks like they knew the answer already.
sfx.direction: Tired of rooms.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.find_out_when_you_putt
sfx.say: You’ll find out when you putt.
sfx.direction: Enjoying himself.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.fine
sfx.say: Fine.
sfx.direction: One syllable, entirely unreadable.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.first_the_job
sfx.say: First, the job. Everybody’s on it.
sfx.direction: Flat, and enormous.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.five_1
sfx.say: Five.
sfx.direction: Not looking up.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.five_2
sfx.say: Five.
sfx.direction: Identical delivery.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.get_in_the_sand
sfx.say: Get in the sand.
sfx.direction: Not unkind. Entirely an instruction.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.good
sfx.say: Good.
sfx.direction: Case closed.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.good_roll
sfx.say: Good roll.
sfx.direction: Two words. From Lou that is a standing ovation.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.good_start_forget_it
sfx.say: Good start. Forget it.
sfx.direction: Both halves are the advice.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.green_falls_toward_water
sfx.say: Green falls toward the water.
sfx.direction: The only genuinely useful read anybody gives, offered without being asked, which is Lou helping.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.had_the_line
sfx.say: Had the line.
sfx.direction: Consoling, barely.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.havent_hit_yours
sfx.say: You haven’t hit yours.
sfx.direction: From the green, not looking over.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.he_finished
sfx.say: He finished.
sfx.direction: Shutting it down, on the Prospect’s side.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.hit_on_sixteen
sfx.say: Try not to spend the whole morning deciding whether to hit on sixteen.
sfx.direction: Over his shoulder, on the tee.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.i_noticed
sfx.say: I noticed. That’s why I didn’t call.
sfx.direction: The compliment is buried and he is not digging it up.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.invited_you
sfx.say: We can find a fourth. We invited you.
sfx.direction: Low, matter-of-fact, no warmth added. Let the significance arrive after the sentence rather than inside it. He does not look at him.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.it_counts
sfx.say: It counts.
sfx.direction: Final and slightly amused.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.it_is_today
sfx.say: It is today.
sfx.direction: Closing it. Three words and Rippin has nowhere to go.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.job_and_night
sfx.say: You’ve got a big job and a big night coming.
sfx.direction: Casual. He has been waiting the whole cart ride to say this.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.job_then_no_prospect
sfx.say: If the job goes how I think, tonight they stop calling you Prospect.
sfx.direction: The whole game, said once, quietly, from a golf cart.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.lucky_a_lot
sfx.say: Once is luck. You’ve been lucky a lot lately.
sfx.direction: The nearest thing to a compliment he owns.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.middle_swing_once
sfx.say: Middle of the green. Swing once.
sfx.direction: The only coaching he gives all morning, and it is the same advice Eric gave. That is the point.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.most_of_the_plane
sfx.say: You brought most of the plane back.
sfx.direction: The same sentence with the compliment removed.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.no
sfx.say: No.
sfx.direction: Not looking. Already knows.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.nobody_invited_you_to_audition
sfx.say: Nobody invited you here to audition. You already did that.
sfx.direction: As the cart slows. He is out of it before the sentence has landed, because staying would make it a speech.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.not_every_time
sfx.say: Not every time.
sfx.direction: The last word, and not a denial.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.not_putting_all_that
sfx.say: We are not putting all of that on the card.
sfx.direction: Pen already moving.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.not_where_he_landed_it
sfx.say: Not where he landed it.
sfx.direction: Dry. This is Lou being funny.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.nothing_wrong_with_boring
sfx.say: Nothing wrong with boring.
sfx.direction: And he is not only talking about the hole.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.noticed_the_car
sfx.say: You noticed the car in the lot. Most people notice the gun and miss the car.
sfx.direction: The highest technical compliment in the game.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.one
sfx.say: One.
sfx.direction: Writing it down.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.one_down_two_to_go
sfx.say: One down. Two to go.
sfx.direction: Closing the card. Satisfied.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.one_hole_doesnt_decide
sfx.say: One hole doesn’t decide anything.
sfx.direction: Meant about more than golf and not flagged as such.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.one_of_them
sfx.say: One of them.
sfx.direction: Not encouraging this.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.parade_before_second_tee
sfx.say: You want a parade before the second tee?
sfx.direction: Affectionate. This is Lou pleased.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.pick_up_the_tee
sfx.say: Pick up the tee.
sfx.direction: No congratulation. Moving him along, which IS the congratulation.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.play_golf_again
sfx.say: Then we play golf again next week and pretend this conversation didn’t happen.
sfx.direction: Kind, and completely serious.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.practiced_before
sfx.say: I practiced before you got here.
sfx.direction: Already over the ball. It is not a boast.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.rarer_than_you_think
sfx.say: That’s rarer than you think.
sfx.direction: Meant. Not softened.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.ready_is_a_word
sfx.say: Ready is a word people use before they know the question.
sfx.direction: Not a put-down.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.rippin_wouldnt
sfx.say: If it was a test, Rippin wouldn’t be administering it.
sfx.direction: Amused, barely.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.six
sfx.say: Six.
sfx.direction: The funniest line Lou has. Play it completely straight.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.six_hands
sfx.say: You also played six hands while I waited.
sfx.direction: Not angry. Filed.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.swing
sfx.say: Swing.
sfx.direction: Ending the subject.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.take_the_drop
sfx.say: Take the drop. Forget the shot.
sfx.direction: The most useful thing anybody says to him all day.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.thats_what_its_for
sfx.say: That is what the thing is for.
sfx.direction: Nodding at the driver. Mild, and it is praise.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.thats_why_we_came
sfx.say: That’s why we came.
sfx.direction: The last line of the scene. He is not being sentimental and it is the most sentimental thing he has ever said.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.there_he_is
sfx.say: There he is. Shoes are wrong, but he’s here.
sfx.direction: Not a greeting. An observation he is happy to have made.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.thinking_lunch
sfx.say: Alright, eight A.M. Let’s start thinking lunch.
sfx.direction: Checking his watch on the way off the tee box. Completely serious about lunch, and not joking about the hour either. Warm, unhurried, already walking.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.three_clubs
sfx.say: Three clubs. You don’t need seventeen ways to make the same mistake.
sfx.direction: Handing it over without ceremony. Advice about golf and about everything else.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.three_holes_rippin
sfx.say: Three holes with Rippin.
sfx.direction: Deadpan.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.waited_for_the_noise
sfx.say: You waited for the noise. That was the important part.
sfx.direction: Very quiet. Neither of them names what the noise was.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.we_see_it
sfx.say: We see it.
sfx.direction: Enough.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.were_not_in_a_hurry
sfx.say: We’re not in a hurry.
sfx.direction: And he genuinely is not. That is the whole morning.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.wings_still_attached
sfx.say: You brought the shipment back with the wings still attached.
sfx.direction: Almost impressed.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.won_more_than_you
sfx.say: He won more than you did.
sfx.direction: Enjoying this.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.wrong_club
sfx.say: You brought the wrong club.
sfx.direction: Watching it sail.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.you_did_good
sfx.say: You did good.
sfx.direction: After a long stretch of nothing but the motor. He does not turn his head. This is the second most important line in the scene.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.you_have_it
sfx.say: You have it.
sfx.direction: Final.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.you_kept_listening
sfx.say: The Bing. The restaurant. The plane. The motel. The boat. You listened when it mattered.
sfx.direction: Counting them off without emphasis.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.lou.you_sat_down
sfx.say: You sat down. You listened. You waited. Same rules out here.
sfx.direction: Three short facts and a fourth that is the whole morning.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.prospect.another_test
sfx.say: Is this a test? Because everything’s been a test and nobody tells me the results.
sfx.direction: Direct and watchful. He has learned what these invitations can mean.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.prospect.arrival_better_shoes
sfx.say: I own better shoes.
sfx.direction: A small defensive correction delivered too late to help.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.prospect.arrival_on_time
sfx.say: You said eight. It’s eight.
sfx.direction: Dry and matter-of-fact. He followed the instruction exactly.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.prospect.arrival_thought_work
sfx.say: I thought this was work.
sfx.direction: Suspicious, but not complaining. He is trying to read the assignment.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.prospect.did_what_you_asked
sfx.say: I did what you asked. All of it. Including the part you didn’t say out loud.
sfx.direction: Professional and restrained. He is reporting, not fishing for praise.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.prospect.earned_morning_off
sfx.say: I figured I earned a morning off.
sfx.direction: Confident without swagger. Testing whether he is allowed to say it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.prospect.fine_good_or_bad
sfx.say: Fine good or fine bad?
sfx.direction: He has learned to ask.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.prospect.got_lucky
sfx.say: I got lucky.
sfx.direction: Modest, with enough experience to know luck was not the whole of it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.prospect.how_much_are_we_putting
sfx.say: How much are we putting?
sfx.direction: He has worked out how this works.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.prospect.how_much_break
sfx.say: How much break?
sfx.direction: Asking for help out loud, which he could not have done on Day One.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.prospect.i_came_back
sfx.say: I came back.
sfx.direction: Steady.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.prospect.if_it_goes_bad
sfx.say: And if it doesn’t go well?
sfx.direction: Careful rather than frightened. He needs to know the consequence.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.prospect.im_ready
sfx.say: I’m ready.
sfx.direction: Certain, concise, no performance of bravery.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.prospect.its_all_love
sfx.say: It’s all love.
sfx.direction: The first time the Prospect uses the house phrase. Play it as a man trying on a jacket that turns out to fit.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.prospect.needed_a_fourth
sfx.say: You needed a fourth.
sfx.direction: Modest on purpose. He is giving Lou an easy answer.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.prospect.no_practice_swing
sfx.say: No practice swing?
sfx.direction: Curious rather than cheeky. He is watching how Lou does things.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.prospect.said_it_was_intentional
sfx.say: You said this was intentional.
sfx.direction: Comfortable enough now to needle him.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.prospect.sitting_wrong
sfx.say: It was sitting wrong.
sfx.direction: Understating it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.prospect.thats_it
sfx.say: That’s it?
sfx.direction: A little wounded.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.prospect.understood
sfx.say: Understood.
sfx.direction: Accepting the instruction without asking Lou to soften it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.prospect.what_happens
sfx.say: What happens?
sfx.direction: Quietly asking Lou to finish the thought.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.prospect.what_happens_at_seven
sfx.say: What happens at seven?
sfx.direction: Plain and direct. This is the question he actually wants answered.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.prospect.what_happens_second
sfx.say: What happens on the second one?
sfx.direction: He wants to know and is trying not to sound like it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.prospect.what_kind_of_job
sfx.say: What kind of job?
sfx.direction: Careful.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.prospect.whats_the_catch
sfx.say: What’s the catch?
sfx.direction: Light joke with a real question underneath it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.prospect.why_am_i_here
sfx.say: So why am I here?
sfx.direction: Asked lightly, because asking it seriously would cost too much.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.prospect.you_gave_me_the_club
sfx.say: You gave me the club.
sfx.direction: Bold. He would not have said this a week ago.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.prospect.you_wanted_information
sfx.say: You said you wanted information.
sfx.direction: The first time he gives one back without checking Lou first.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.absolutely_not
sfx.say: No. Absolutely not.
sfx.direction: After two full seconds of nobody saying anything. Genuine outrage.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.aim_for_the_bushes
sfx.say: Aim for the bushes next time. They float better.
sfx.direction: The old line, deployed with love.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.all_love
sfx.say: It’s all love.
sfx.direction: The house phrase. Warm and completely automatic.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.all_love_2
sfx.say: It’s all love.
sfx.direction: Retreating.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.all_love_3
sfx.say: It’s all love.
sfx.direction: Deploying the phrase as a bargaining chip.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.buy_a_lesson
sfx.say: Use the slot money and buy a lesson.
sfx.direction: Bitter about the machine.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.cant_leave_a_big_night_short
sfx.say: You can’t leave a big night short.
sfx.direction: Enormously pleased with the callback.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.close_the_face
sfx.say: Or close the face and hit the ball directly.
sfx.direction: Confidently wrong.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.credentials
sfx.say: I have credentials.
sfx.direction: Wounded.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.dont_trust_witnesses
sfx.say: I don’t trust witnesses.
sfx.direction: A whole character in four words.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.easy_prospect
sfx.say: Easy, Prospect.
sfx.direction: Stepping back. Amused, not alarmed.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.enough_information
sfx.say: Now we have enough information.
sfx.direction: The bit, completed. He is thrilled.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.eric_not_cricket
sfx.say: Eric, this isn’t cricket.
sfx.direction: Heckling for the sake of it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.exactly_where
sfx.say: Exactly where I wanted it.
sfx.direction: Instantly, before the sand has settled.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.finally_somebody_hits_it
sfx.say: Finally. Somebody out here hits it.
sfx.direction: As though he has been waiting years.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.first_hole_ace
sfx.say: First hole with us and he gets an ace?
sfx.direction: To Lou, appealing to a higher court.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.first_tee
sfx.say: For him, that’s the first tee.
sfx.direction: Instant. He had this ready before the sentence finished.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.five_is_fair
sfx.say: Five is fair.
sfx.direction: Instantly.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.four
sfx.say: Four.
sfx.direction: Trying it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.golf_shoes
sfx.say: Those are golf shoes if you stop respecting golf.
sfx.direction: Delighted with himself. Already mid-practice-swing.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.good_thing_not_the_big_night
sfx.say: Good thing this isn’t the big night.
sfx.direction: Cheerfully.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.ground_under_repair
sfx.say: That was ground under repair.
sfx.direction: Opening negotiations.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.havent_said_anything
sfx.say: I haven’t said anything.
sfx.direction: Indignant.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.hit_it_again
sfx.say: Hit it again. Something might change.
sfx.direction: Supportive in the least useful way.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.hitting_slowly
sfx.say: That is hitting the hole slowly.
sfx.direction: Pleased with the logic.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.i_do
sfx.say: I do.
sfx.direction: Immediate. No shame whatsoever.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.ill_brief_you
sfx.say: I’ll brief you.
sfx.direction: Thrilled to have been got.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.information
sfx.say: I wanted information about the bunker.
sfx.direction: Committing hard to the bit.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.inspect_scorecard
sfx.say: I want the scorecard inspected.
sfx.direction: Still not over it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.job_big_one_today
sfx.say: So the job’s the big one today.
sfx.direction: Filling a wait, and not entirely by accident.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.know_what_i_said
sfx.say: I know what I said.
sfx.direction: Standing by it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.know_what_im_doing
sfx.say: I know what I’m doing.
sfx.direction: He does not.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.learned_that_from_me
sfx.say: He learned that from me.
sfx.direction: Instantly claiming it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.let_him_cook
sfx.say: No. Let him cook.
sfx.direction: Absolutely serious.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.let_me_watch_you
sfx.say: Let me watch you let you watch me.
sfx.direction: He does not know where the sentence is going either.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.located_grass
sfx.say: Let it be known, the Prospect has located grass.
sfx.direction: Announcing it to the whole course.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.more_expensive
sfx.say: And more expensive. Lou never pays for the fourth.
sfx.direction: Breaking the moment on purpose, the way friends do.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.more_talking_than_golf
sfx.say: And more talking than golf.
sfx.direction: Complaining about the thing he loves.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.more_than_that_ball
sfx.say: More than that ball.
sfx.direction: Winning.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.needed_repair
sfx.say: It needed repair.
sfx.direction: Airtight, in his view.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.next_ones_long
sfx.say: Next one’s long.
sfx.direction: Already walking.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.not_on_the_scorecard
sfx.say: Not on the scorecard.
sfx.direction: Warmly.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.not_the_whole_job
sfx.say: It is not the whole job.
sfx.direction: Cannot let a compliment stand unsupervised.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.now_its_a_meeting
sfx.say: Good. Now it’s a meeting.
sfx.direction: Delighted to have company in the sand.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.oldest_man_shot
sfx.say: That is the oldest-man shot I’ve ever seen.
sfx.direction: Real admiration disguised as an insult.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.par_three
sfx.say: Par three. One-sixty-seven. Water right, bunker left, dignity everywhere.
sfx.direction: Reading the hole like a man announcing a fight.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.piping_hot
sfx.say: Piping hot.
sfx.direction: Genuine. He is pleased and slightly annoyed about being pleased.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.piping_hot_2
sfx.say: Piping hot.
sfx.direction: Unreserved.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.plane_has_a_runway
sfx.say: A plane has a runway.
sfx.direction: Objecting.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.receipt_and_jacket
sfx.say: You wake up with a receipt in your pocket and somebody else’s jacket.
sfx.direction: Fond memory. Not a warning.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.reject_the_event
sfx.say: Let it be known, I reject the event.
sfx.direction: Formally.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.safe_1
sfx.say: Safe.
sfx.direction: An accusation.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.safe_2
sfx.say: Safe.
sfx.direction: Same word, no less certain.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.saving_words
sfx.say: He’s saving his words for the scorecard.
sfx.direction: Filling the silence because somebody has to and it is always him.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.second_one_is_fun
sfx.say: The second one is the fun one.
sfx.direction: Lighting up.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.several_trees_first
sfx.say: He has several trees first.
sfx.direction: Helpfully.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.slots_arent_golf
sfx.say: Slots aren’t golf.
sfx.direction: Retreating to principle.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.social_calendar
sfx.say: Front-row table, golf with Lou. Prospect’s social calendar is piping hot.
sfx.direction: Genuinely pleased for him and refusing to show it straight.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.still_invited
sfx.say: Still invited.
sfx.direction: A joke that is also the reassurance.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.still_moving_1
sfx.say: Still moving.
sfx.direction: Narrating.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.still_moving_2
sfx.say: Still moving.
sfx.direction: Same delivery. That is the joke.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.that_is_criminal
sfx.say: That is criminal.
sfx.direction: Outraged on his behalf.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.thats_golf
sfx.say: That’s golf.
sfx.direction: Generous, for him.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.thirty_seconds
sfx.say: You got thirty fucking seconds before I start coaching.
sfx.direction: Loud, cheerful, and a promise rather than a threat.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.took_his_time
sfx.say: He took his time. That was the problem.
sfx.direction: Immediately undoing the kindness.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.two_schools
sfx.say: Two schools of thought.
sfx.direction: Serene.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.visualizing_hole_two
sfx.say: I’m visualizing Hole Two.
sfx.direction: Unbothered. It is, in his mind, a complete defence.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.watch_this
sfx.say: Watch this.
sfx.direction: Genuine confidence. That is what makes it funny.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.welcome
sfx.say: Welcome.
sfx.direction: Hosting. From inside the bunker.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h1.rippin.yours_worries_me
sfx.say: It was. Yours worries me.
sfx.direction: Sincere concern, briefly.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.eric.clubhouse_behind_the_last
sfx.say: Last one comes back to the clubhouse.
sfx.direction: A fact about geography.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.eric.dogleg_right
sfx.say: It doglegs right at the pines. You cannot see the corner from here.
sfx.direction: Information, offered before anybody asks for it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.eric.first_honest_thing
sfx.say: That is the first honest thing anybody has said on a tee this morning.
sfx.direction: Warm. It is the closest Eric comes to liking somebody out loud.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.eric.gratin_butter_chicken
sfx.say: Gratin still owes me a proper butter chicken. He has been to India. He has *seen* it done.
sfx.direction: The one subject Eric will not let go of.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.eric.green_is_long
sfx.say: Green’s long and it runs away from you at the back.
sfx.direction: The read, offered as always without being asked.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.eric.he_had_a_point
sfx.say: It came on while he was over the ball. He had a point.
sfx.direction: Fair-minded to a fault.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.eric.he_thinks_weather_is_rigged
sfx.say: He thinks the weather is rigged.
sfx.direction: Deadpan.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.eric.i_know_he_uses_a_jar
sfx.say: I know he uses a jar. That is the entire problem.
sfx.direction: The only time Eric sounds genuinely wounded all morning.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.eric.it_was_windy
sfx.say: It was windy.
sfx.direction: Closing it down, kindly.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.eric.let_him_think
sfx.say: Let him think.
sfx.direction: Quiet.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.eric.lou
sfx.say: Lou.
sfx.direction: One syllable. Not a rebuke — a check.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.eric.sand_is_on_that_line
sfx.say: The sand is on that line.
sfx.direction: A fact, delivered to nobody in particular.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.eric.six
sfx.say: Six.
sfx.direction: Writing nothing. Just saying it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.eric.that_is_not_what_happened
sfx.say: That is not what happened.
sfx.direction: Tired.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.eric.that_is_the_game
sfx.say: That is the game.
sfx.direction: Mid-swing.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.eric.that_is_the_sand
sfx.say: That is the sand.
sfx.direction: Not gloating. Reporting.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.eric.that_was_a_compliment
sfx.say: That was a compliment.
sfx.direction: Translating, because somebody has to.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.eric.thats_after_the_job
sfx.say: That’s after the job, yes.
sfx.direction: Confirming a fixture.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.eric.there_is_sand_there
sfx.say: There is sand there.
sfx.direction: Flat.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.lou.another_lou
sfx.say: There’s a captain for it already. Not me. Another Lou. You’ll know him when you see him — he’s the one holding a clipboard and looking at the weather.
sfx.direction: Fond and faintly exasperated, the way you talk about a cousin who is very good at one thing. Then straight back to the putt.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.lou.dont
sfx.say: Don’t.
sfx.direction: Too late.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.lou.dont_copy_me
sfx.say: Don’t copy me. I’m playing this for a five and I’m happy about it.
sfx.direction: Entirely at peace with his own game.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.lou.driver
sfx.say: Driver. Both of you.
sfx.direction: Permission, and it is the first time he has given any.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.lou.good_ole_days
sfx.say: Good ole days.
sfx.direction: Not nostalgic. Two words, put down like a stone.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.lou.he_did_not_cry
sfx.say: He did not cry.
sfx.direction: Protective, barely.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.lou.hes_going_to_find_out
sfx.say: He finds out in a couple of weeks either way. He can find out now with a putter in his hand.
sfx.direction: To Eric, about the Prospect, in front of the Prospect.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.lou.hes_right_about_the_weather
sfx.say: He’s right about the weather.
sfx.direction: Completely unreadable.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.lou.i_know_they_are
sfx.say: I know they are. That’s why he’s here.
sfx.direction: He does not look at the Prospect. This is the second time all morning he has said why, and he says it to Rippin instead.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.lou.im_in_the_fairway
sfx.say: I’m in the fairway. They’re in a conversation about sand.
sfx.direction: Dry, and it is the whole philosophy of the man.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.lou.im_playing_for_a_five
sfx.say: I’m playing for a five.
sfx.direction: Not looking up. He will be proved right and they both know it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.lou.its_a_golf_course
sfx.say: It’s a golf course, Rip. They all do that.
sfx.direction: And the joke lands on the far side of something true.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.lou.longer_than_it_looks
sfx.say: Everything out here is longer than it looks.
sfx.direction: And he is not talking about the hole.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.lou.nehoo
sfx.say: Nehoo with a guu.
sfx.direction: Under his breath. Not for anybody.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.lou.nobody_lost_a_hole_wide
sfx.say: Nobody ever lost a hole from the wide side. They just took longer getting home.
sfx.direction: Approval that sounds like a shrug.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.lou.one_thing_at_a_time
sfx.say: One thing at a time.
sfx.direction: Closing it, without any weight on it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.lou.same_sand
sfx.say: Same sand.
sfx.direction: Walking past him.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.lou.six_2
sfx.say: Six.
sfx.direction: Identical to the last time he did this.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.lou.six_thousand_pounds_of_it
sfx.say: Six thousand pounds of it. It doesn’t go in a van and it doesn’t go in this conversation.
sfx.direction: Cheerful. He is telling him the weight and nothing else, and the weight is the most frightening part.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.lou.thing_after_the_thing
sfx.say: One thing at a time. Although — there’s a thing after the thing, and it needs an aeroplane.
sfx.direction: Reading a putt while he says it. The aside is not an aside and he knows exactly how it lands.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.lou.three_shots_to_get_there
sfx.say: Three shots to get there. You have got room to be wrong twice.
sfx.direction: Advice, and permission, in one sentence.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.lou.two_down
sfx.say: Two down. One to go.
sfx.direction: Closing the card.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.prospect.an_aeroplane
sfx.say: An aeroplane.
sfx.direction: Repeating the word to see whether it changes.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.prospect.cut_the_corner
sfx.say: I’m cutting the corner.
sfx.direction: Committing out loud before he can talk himself out of it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.prospect.know_when_im_over_it
sfx.say: I’ll know when I’m stood over it.
sfx.direction: The truth, offered without decoration.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.prospect.ten_drunk_cigarettes
sfx.say: Somebody said something about ten drunk cigarettes.
sfx.direction: Trying it out. Testing whether he is allowed the vocabulary.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.prospect.what_eggs
sfx.say: What eggs?
sfx.direction: He has learned that asking is usually a mistake and asks anyway.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.prospect.whatever_lou_hits
sfx.say: Whatever Lou hits.
sfx.direction: Half a joke. Only half.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.prospect.wide_and_safe
sfx.say: Wide. I’ll take the extra shot.
sfx.direction: Unglamorous and completely deliberate.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.prospect.you_hit_it_short
sfx.say: You hit it shorter than both of them.
sfx.direction: Not a criticism. He is working something out.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.ape_says_cheating
sfx.say: Ape came out once. Accused a sprinkler of cheating.
sfx.direction: Fondly.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.booski_rigged
sfx.say: Booskibro thinks this course is rigged. He thinks *golf* is rigged.
sfx.direction: Delighted.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.different_sand
sfx.say: Different sand.
sfx.direction: Committed.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.eleven_months
sfx.say: Eleven months he’s been on it. Eleven.
sfx.direction: Awed.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.eric_finds_it_every_time
sfx.say: Eric hits it nowhere and finds it every time.
sfx.direction: The closest he gets to a compliment.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.five
sfx.say: Five.
sfx.direction: Reflex.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.he_uses_a_jar
sfx.say: He uses a jar.
sfx.direction: Betraying a friend without hesitating.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.hes_playing_for_a_six
sfx.say: He’s playing for a six.
sfx.direction: Instantly.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.his_eyes_were_wet
sfx.say: His eyes were wet.
sfx.direction: Legally precise.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.hog_mama_bus
sfx.say: Hog Mama drove the bus to Atlantic City. Hog Mama *became* the bus.
sfx.direction: A sentence he has clearly said before and will say again.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.i_can_see_it
sfx.say: I can see it.
sfx.direction: He cannot.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.i_like_the_back
sfx.say: I like the back.
sfx.direction: He does not.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.irish_and_the_eggs
sfx.say: Irish is still looking into the eggs.
sfx.direction: As though this is ordinary.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.its_all_love_4
sfx.say: It’s all love.
sfx.direction: Beaten, and enjoying being beaten.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.not_where_im_going
sfx.say: Not where I’m going.
sfx.direction: Certain.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.now_we_talk
sfx.say: Five-twenty. Now we’re talking.
sfx.direction: Genuinely happy. This is his hole and he knows it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.oh_hes_heard
sfx.say: Oh, he’s heard.
sfx.direction: Enormously pleased.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.sallie_j_hit_one
sfx.say: Sallie J hit one out here once. Still going, far as anybody knows.
sfx.direction: Looking off into the trees.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.sand_is_everywhere
sfx.say: The sand is everywhere, Eric.
sfx.direction: Waving it away. He is not wrong and it does not help.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.shubes_cried
sfx.say: Shubes cried on the ninth at Ridgemont. Openly.
sfx.direction: The best story he has.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.so_it_ends_where_it_started
sfx.say: So it ends where it started. Poetic.
sfx.direction: Being funny, and accidentally not.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.squatch_up
sfx.say: Squatch up, Prospect. It’s a par five, not a funeral.
sfx.direction: Loud, across the fairway.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.thats_how_i_tell_it
sfx.say: That’s how I tell it.
sfx.direction: Unmovable.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.thats_my_boy
sfx.say: That is my boy.
sfx.direction: Enormous. He has been waiting all morning for somebody to be reckless.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.theyre_still_going
sfx.say: They’re still going, Lou.
sfx.direction: Gently. This is Rippin being kind, which he does about once a year.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.two_holes_two_bunkers
sfx.say: Two holes. Two bunkers. There’s a pattern forming and I don’t care for it.
sfx.direction: Aggrieved at the universe.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.watch_the_corner
sfx.say: I’m going over the corner.
sfx.direction: Announcing a plan nobody asked to hear.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h2.rippin.which_side
sfx.say: Right. Corner’s out there somewhere behind those pines. Which side are you playing, Prospect?
sfx.direction: Genuinely wants to know, and is going to have an opinion either way.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.booski.fourth_mans_in
sfx.say: Fourth man’s in. That’s the morning.
sfx.direction: Raising the can about two inches. From him that is a standing ovation.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.booski.there_he_is
sfx.say: There he is. Take your time. We’ve only been stood out here since seven.
sfx.direction: Can in hand, not moving an inch. Delighted and complaining.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.deathmegatron.cigar_with_your_name
sfx.say: I’ve got a cigar with your name on it and I am not giving it to you.
sfx.direction: The warmest thing he has ever said to anybody.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.deathmegatron.two_putt
sfx.say: Two-putt it and we all go inside.
sfx.direction: Around a cigar he is not taking out of his mouth.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.eric.good_morning_for_it
sfx.say: Good morning for it.
sfx.direction: Looking at the sky, meaning something else.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.eric.last_green_of_the_day
sfx.say: Last green. Take a second on it.
sfx.direction: Kind, and the most Eric thing he says all morning.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.eric.leave_it_rip
sfx.say: Leave it, Rip.
sfx.direction: And Rippin does, which tells you he understood.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.eric.most_useful_thing_all_day
sfx.say: That is the most useful thing he has said all day.
sfx.direction: And he means the whole day, golf included.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.eric.provisionally
sfx.say: Provisionally.
sfx.direction: Dry.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.eric.that_is_devastating
sfx.say: That is devastating.
sfx.direction: Impressed.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.eric.there_is_sand_at_two_ten
sfx.say: Sand at two hundred and ten. Right side.
sfx.direction: To the Prospect, not to Rippin.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.eric.two_eleven
sfx.say: Two hundred and eleven.
sfx.direction: Watching it come down.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.lou.anybody_know_youre_here
sfx.say: Before you hit. Does anybody know you’re out here this morning?
sfx.direction: Conversational. He asks it the way he would ask about traffic, and it is the most serious question of the round.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.lou.breaks_toward_the_building
sfx.say: Breaks toward the building. Everything here does.
sfx.direction: The last read he gives, and it is a joke about the club.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.lou.but_they_wont
sfx.say: They won’t.
sfx.direction: Two words, thrown away, and he is already walking.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.lou.golf
sfx.say: Golf.
sfx.direction: Flat.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.lou.golf_is_the_true_half
sfx.say: Golf is the true half. Tell people the true half and stop there.
sfx.direction: Practical instruction, given like a club recommendation.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.lou.he_did_hear_you
sfx.say: He did hear you.
sfx.direction: Enjoying his morning.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.lou.i_thought_about_it_on_one
sfx.say: I thought about it on the first. It’s all love.
sfx.direction: Using Rippin’s own phrase on him. This is Lou being playful.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.lou.job_between_now_and_seven
sfx.say: There’s a job between now and seven. Nothing you can do about either one from a fairway. That’s why we’re out here.
sfx.direction: The whole reason for the morning, stated once, on the last hole, as though it were a small practical matter.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.lou.no
sfx.say: No.
sfx.direction: Not looking up.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.lou.right_answer_wrong_life
sfx.say: That’s the right answer. I didn’t want it to be.
sfx.direction: A flicker of something, gone before you can name it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.lou.sad_or_professional
sfx.say: That’s either very sad or very professional.
sfx.direction: Not unkind. He has met both.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.lou.seven_oclock
sfx.say: Seven o’clock. Don’t be early.
sfx.direction: The last line of the morning. He is already walking to the car. Do not make it heavy — the whole point is that he says it the way you would tell somebody where to park.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.lou.thats_the_round
sfx.say: That’s the round.
sfx.direction: Closing the card for the last time.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.lou.then_they_say_no
sfx.say: Then they say no, and I still know where you live, and we still play golf.
sfx.direction: Absolutely level. It is the most reassuring thing he could have said.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.lou.three_ninety_five
sfx.say: Three ninety-five. Bends left. Clubhouse behind the green.
sfx.direction: Reading the hole, and the last sentence is the one that matters.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.lou.today_it_matters
sfx.say: Today it does. Tomorrow it won’t. Hit your ball.
sfx.direction: And the subject is closed by the man who opened it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.lou.you_know_whats_at_seven
sfx.say: You know what’s at seven.
sfx.direction: Not a question. First time either of them has said the hour out loud, and he says it while looking down the fairway.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.numbskull.it_is_though
sfx.say: It is, though.
sfx.direction: Standing by it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.numbskull.three_putt_is_funnier
sfx.say: Three-putt’s funnier.
sfx.direction: Immediately, and he means it kindly.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.prospect.does_it_matter
sfx.say: Does it matter?
sfx.direction: Testing whether he is allowed to ask that yet.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.prospect.i_know
sfx.say: I know.
sfx.direction: Steady. No performance in it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.prospect.ill_be_here
sfx.say: I’ll be here.
sfx.direction: And he means it, and everybody hears that he means it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.prospect.nobody_knows
sfx.say: Nobody.
sfx.direction: Immediate, and he hears how that sounds after he says it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.prospect.told_margo
sfx.say: I told Margo I was playing golf.
sfx.direction: Careful. He is watching Lou’s face for the answer.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.prospect.what_if_they_say_no
sfx.say: What if they say no?
sfx.direction: Quiet. The question he has been carrying since the car park.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.prospect.who_would_i_tell
sfx.say: Who would I tell?
sfx.direction: Blunt, and sadder than he means it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.rippin.can_be_both
sfx.say: It can be both.
sfx.direction: From the next tee marker, and for once he is being serious.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.rippin.didnt_even_think
sfx.say: You didn’t even think about it.
sfx.direction: Outraged.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.rippin.final_accounting
sfx.say: Right. Final accounting. I want my four back from the first.
sfx.direction: Opening negotiations he has already lost.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.rippin.i_can_see_the_bar
sfx.say: I can see the bar from the tee. That’s a design decision.
sfx.direction: Approving.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.rippin.i_heard_you
sfx.say: I heard you.
sfx.direction: From the sand.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.rippin.im_taking_two_seconds
sfx.say: I’m taking two.
sfx.direction: Softer than usual.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.rippin.it_is_all_love
sfx.say: It *is* all love. That’s the tragedy of it.
sfx.direction: Beaten and completely happy.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.rippin.last_one
sfx.say: Last one. Everybody still friends?
sfx.direction: Cheerful, and checking.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.rippin.same_time_next_week
sfx.say: Same time next week, Prospect.
sfx.direction: Said as an ordinary arrangement, which is the single warmest thing anybody says to him all day — because it assumes a next week.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.rippin.two_ten_is_not_a_problem
sfx.say: Two-ten is not a problem for me.
sfx.direction: It is about to be.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.rippin.what_are_we_talking_about
sfx.say: What are we talking about over there?
sfx.direction: From forty yards away, because he cannot bear it.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.shubenator.grille_is_open
sfx.say: Balcony’s open. Lou’s buying, which means Eric’s buying.
sfx.direction: Already turning toward the steps.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.shubenator.theres_a_bar_up_here
sfx.say: There is a bar thirty feet behind me, Prospect. Thirty feet, and I am out here.
sfx.direction: Genuine sympathy, expressed as a grievance about himself.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.snow.he_means_come_up
sfx.say: He means come up.
sfx.direction: Translating, once, with a nod at the terrace over the green, and going back to his beer.

sfx.name: vo.golf.h3.snow.numbskull
sfx.say: Numbskull.
sfx.direction: One word, flat, without turning round.

sfx.name: vo.machine.lou.golf_morning.0
sfx.say: Message. Today. 6:02 AM.

sfx.name: vo.machine.lou.golf_morning.1
sfx.say: Morning, kid. Keep the line clear and do not ring back.

sfx.name: vo.machine.lou.golf_morning.2
sfx.say: Silver Pines has a second gate. You will hear the rest from me.

sfx.name: vo.machine.lou.golf_morning.3
sfx.say: Wear something you can walk in. I will call when the car is moving.

sfx.name: vo.machine.lou.heist_day.0
sfx.say: Message. Today. 6:02 AM.

sfx.name: vo.machine.lou.heist_day.1
sfx.say: Today is the day, kid. Keep the line clear and do not ring back.

sfx.name: vo.machine.lou.heist_day.2
sfx.say: Everything you have done this week was somebody asking a question. Today is the answer.

sfx.name: vo.machine.lou.heist_day.3
sfx.say: Eat. Dress plain. I will call when the car is moving.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.arrival.prospect.humming
sfx.say: Whatever’s in here has been humming since the car.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.arrival.rippin.balls
sfx.say: Whatever’s in that thing, I don’t want it near my balls.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.arrival.rippin.overthere
sfx.say: I’m serious. Take it over there.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.arrival.eric.mood
sfx.say: Lou’s waiting for you. And he’s been in one of those moods.

sfx.say: It’s always you doing this.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.torture.gratin.kitchensdead
sfx.say: I’m good at it, and the kitchen’s dead this time of night.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.torture.gratin.youwantago
sfx.say: You want a go? Everybody gets one. It keeps him talking.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.torture.gratin.letthetenddoit
sfx.say: Here. It’s a cord, not a bat — let the end of it do the work.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.torture.gratin.panonupstairs
sfx.say: I’ve got a pan on upstairs. Take your turn or don’t.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.torture.gratin.suityourself
sfx.say: Suit yourself. He’s not going anywhere.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.torture.xxx.ouchone
sfx.say: Hn — GHK—

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.corridor.xxx.takethecar
sfx.say: You can take the car… you can take the mission…

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.corridor.xxx.turnyourback
sfx.say: But you don’t turn your back on family.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.torture.gratin.hesfine
sfx.say: See? He’s fine.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.torture.xxx.ouchtwo
sfx.say: Agh — Christ—

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.torture.xxx.hitlikefamily
sfx.say: You hit like family.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.torture.xxx.notacompliment
sfx.say: That’s not a compliment. That’s just what they do.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.torture.xxx.theelbow
sfx.say: There it is. You’ve got the elbow into it now.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.torture.xxx.ouchthree
sfx.say: Hhh—!

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.torture.xxx.stoppedatone
sfx.say: Go on. Nobody in this house has ever stopped at one.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.torture.xxx.ouchfour
sfx.say: Nn—! …Ah.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.torture.xxx.inthemorning
sfx.say: That one’s going to be there in the morning.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.torture.gratin.hecounts
sfx.say: He’s counting. He always counts.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.torture.gratin.oneeach
sfx.say: One each. House rule.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.house.sasole.notflying
sfx.say: I’m not flying anything tonight, so don’t look at me like that.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.house.sasole.didntseeit
sfx.say: Whatever’s in the case, I didn’t carry it and I didn’t see it.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.house.numbskull.nobodyswims
sfx.say: Nobody swims. It’s heated and nobody swims.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.house.numbskull.hearthegate
sfx.say: I like it out here. You can hear the gate.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.house.hogmama.theresfood
sfx.say: There’s food. Nobody in this house eats, but there’s food.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.house.hogmama.leftapanon
sfx.say: Gratin left a pan on and went downstairs. Again.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.house.rippin.pool.finally
sfx.say: Finally. Rack’s been sitting there so long it’s got a lease.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.house.rippin.pool.youbreak
sfx.say: You break. And don’t be gentle with it, this isn’t church.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.house.rippin.pool.remembered
sfx.say: Look who remembered where he left the table.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.house.rippin.pool.onpurpose
sfx.say: Alright. That one went in on purpose, I’ll allow it.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.house.rippin.pool.nothing
sfx.say: Nothing. Twenty minutes I waited for that.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.house.rippin.pool.ballinhand
sfx.say: Foul. Ball in my hand, and now we’re playing my game.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.house.rippin.pool.movestanding
sfx.say: Move. You’re standing in the shot.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.house.rippin.pool.thewrist
sfx.say: That’s the wrist. You can’t teach the wrist.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.house.rippin.pool.crookedtable
sfx.say: Table’s crooked. Lou paid nine grand for a crooked table.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.house.rippin.pool.thatstheframe
sfx.say: And that’s the frame. Don’t look at me like that, you were there the whole time.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.house.rippin.pool.rackemagain
sfx.say: Rack ’em again, prospect. I’ve got all night and you’ve got nowhere to be.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.house.rippin.pool.doesntcount
sfx.say: Okay. Okay. That was one frame and it doesn’t count.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.house.rippin.pool.nobodyhears
sfx.say: Nobody in this house hears about this. Nobody.

sfx.name: vo.silentsquatch.house.rippin.pool.leaveitthere
sfx.say: Sure. Leave it there. I’ll just keep standing here, it’s what I do.

sfx.name: vo.siege.wake.prospect.awake
sfx.say: Okay. Okay — that is not the television.

sfx.name: vo.siege.wake.guard.inside
sfx.say: They are inside! They are in the house — get to the armory!

sfx.name: vo.siege.guide.booski.armory
sfx.say: Kid — armory. East end of the cellar hall, then south through the door. Move.

sfx.name: vo.siege.guide.booski.office
sfx.say: Now get up here. Basement stair, straight over the foyer, up the horseshoe — Lou is on the top floor.

sfx.name: vo.siege.briefing.prospect.report
sfx.say: Lou. There were two of them in the cellar.

sfx.name: vo.siege.briefing.lou.forty
sfx.say: Two in the cellar. There are forty on my lawn.

sfx.name: vo.siege.briefing.booski.drive
sfx.say: More coming up the drive — both sides of the fountain, they are not even hurrying.

sfx.name: vo.siege.briefing.lou.upstairs
sfx.say: Everybody upstairs. Nobody holds a ground-floor room tonight, I do not care whose room it is.

sfx.name: vo.siege.briefing.lou.stairs
sfx.say: You. Take the rail over the foyer. Anything that comes through my front door, you put it down on my floor.

sfx.name: vo.siege.briefing.prospect.stairs
sfx.say: The stairs. Got it.

sfx.name: vo.siege.briefing.lou.heavy
sfx.say: And get the big one up. You did not carry it out of my armory to look at it.

sfx.name: vo.siege.prospect.little_friend
sfx.say: Say hello to my little friend.

sfx.name: vo.siege.lull.booski.reload
sfx.say: That is the first lot! Reload — they are forming up again on the drive!

sfx.name: vo.siege.lull.lou.notover
sfx.say: It is not over. Watch that door.

sfx.name: vo.siege.flank.deathmegatron.glass
sfx.say: Glass! West wing and east — they are coming in behind us!

sfx.name: vo.siege.aftermath.lou.last
sfx.say: That is the last of them. Somebody kill that alarm.

sfx.name: vo.siege.aftermath.lou.house
sfx.say: They came to my house. With cars, and a plan, and enough men to spare four of them for a window.

sfx.name: vo.siege.aftermath.lou.budget
sfx.say: This is not a neighbourhood thing any more, kid. This is somebody with a budget.

sfx.name: vo.siege.aftermath.lou.sasole
sfx.say: There is a man on my landing in a flight jacket. Captain Lou Sasole. Go and talk to him — he is how we answer this.

sfx.name: vo.siege.aftermath.prospect.sasole
sfx.say: Sasole. Right.

sfx.name: vo.siege.sasole.sasole.stairs
sfx.say: You are the one who held the stairs. Good. Then you can hold a bomb bay.

sfx.name: vo.siege.sasole.sasole.tonight
sfx.say: Get some sleep. We fly tonight, and you are coming with me.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.mark.arrival.quiet-1.1
sfx.say: Tony. Sit down. We are having the veal — Sauce’s recipe. He was going to tell you. Eventually.
sfx.direction: Unhurried cartel-boss calm. A man offering dinner to the intruder in his house, certain the house wins.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.mark.arrival.loud-1.1
sfx.say: You shot your way through my payroll to ruin a Tuesday dinner. Sit down anyway. The veal is getting cold.
sfx.direction: Dry, annoyed, unafraid — the gunfire outside was an inconvenience to his evening, not a threat to his life.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.tony.accuse-1.1
sfx.say: Six months. Six months I burned this state down looking for you, Sauce.
sfx.direction: Low and level, the anger already spent. He is not asking a question.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.tony.accuse.belongings-1.1
sfx.say: Your knives are folded in the guest suite next to your passport. Prisoners don’t get turn-down service.
sfx.direction: Flat prosecutor’s delivery, laying the first exhibit on the table.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.tony.accuse.ledger-1.1
sfx.say: Mark’s ledger pays you every other Friday. Hostages don’t get direct deposit.
sfx.direction: Second exhibit. Drier than the first — the joke is a scalpel, not a smile.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.tony.accuse.still-1.1
sfx.say: And the cameras caught you waving them goodnight. Nobody has ever chained you to anything.
sfx.direction: The last exhibit, and the coldest. The sentence ends the argument.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.sauce.admission.cornered-1.1
sfx.say: Okay. Yeah. The kidnapping was less of a kidnapping and more of a — Mark, help me with the word.
sfx.direction: Caught flat and scrambling, hands half-raised, appealing sideways to his boss mid-sentence.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.mark.admission.cornered-2.1
sfx.say: A rebrand.
sfx.direction: One bored word. He has said it in meetings before.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.sauce.admission.cornered-3.1
sfx.say: A rebrand. The family paid me in exposure and gunfire, Tony. Here I get dental. And a pool.
sfx.direction: Relieved to have the word, then genuinely, indefensibly sincere about the dental.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.sauce.admission.pressed-1.1
sfx.say: Whoa, whoa. ‘Never a prisoner’ is a strong read. I was reluctant. At first. The first week. Day. The drive over.
sfx.direction: Backpedalling in real time, the timeline collapsing under him word by word.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.sauce.admission.denial-1.1
sfx.say: Prisoner! That’s me. Blink twice, right? I’m blinking, Tony. This is me, blinking.
sfx.direction: Terrible acting, performed with full commitment. He blinks audibly if that is possible.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.mark.mark.cornered-1.1
sfx.say: He cooks, I pay, and nobody down there missed him until the food got worse. I’d apologize, but look at my house. I’m not sorry about anything.
sfx.direction: Resigned and expansive. He has seen the ledger on the table and skipped straight past denial to legacy.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.mark.mark.pressed-1.1
sfx.say: He begged me for this job. Ask the wall he did not climb over.
sfx.direction: Deflecting with contempt, gesturing at the architecture as his witness.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.mark.mark.denial-1.1
sfx.say: You broke into my home with a theory and a rifle. One of those is loaded.
sfx.direction: Amused, superior. He thinks the evidence is thin and he is enjoying saying so.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.wife.begging.wife-1.1
sfx.say: No, no, no. Baby — whoever you are — not the face. He just had work done. There is a DEPOSIT.
sfx.direction: Desperate glamorous begging at full volume. “DEPOSIT” lands like a bereavement.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.wife.begging.wife-2.1
sfx.say: Take the cars. Take Sauce — he over-salts everything anyway—
sfx.direction: Bargaining fast, throwing the chef overboard without a flicker of hesitation.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.sauce.begging.wife-3.1
sfx.say: Hey!
sfx.direction: Wounded. The over-salting accusation hurts more than the rifle.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.wife.begging.wife-4.1
sfx.say: —but nobody dies at dinner. This rug is hand-knotted. Blood never comes out of hand-knotted.
sfx.direction: Pleading for lives and upholstery in the same breath, and she means both equally.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.lola.begging.shorts-1.1
sfx.say: Boss man, listen. Me and him, we have personally witnessed maybe four hundred murders—
sfx.direction: A short, urgent professional opening a negotiation. Fast, sincere, hands out.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.johnny.begging.shorts-2.1
sfx.say: —five hundred—
sfx.direction: Correcting his partner instantly, like they keep a shared spreadsheet.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.lola.begging.shorts-3.1
sfx.say: —five hundred murders, and not one of them improved the evening.
sfx.direction: Accepting the correction without pause and finishing the shared sentence.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.johnny.begging.shorts-4.1
sfx.say: Kill nobody, and we validate parking. Kill somebody, and we scream, we dive under the table, it becomes a whole thing.
sfx.direction: Laying out both packages like a waiter reciting specials. Deadly serious about the logistics.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.lola.begging.shorts-5.1
sfx.say: It is rehearsed, but it is a whole thing.
sfx.direction: Quiet, confidential postscript. She is not proud that it is rehearsed. She is a little proud.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.mark.go-1.1
sfx.say: Enough. He did not climb my wall to hear the help negotiate.
sfx.direction: The boss ends the begging. Chair pushed back, evening over.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.tony.go-2.1
sfx.say: The ledger says you bought him. The footage says he sold us. I say dinner’s over.
sfx.direction: Verdict. Ice-flat, no rise at the end. The safety comes off on the last word.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.mark.go-3.1
sfx.say: It is. Sauce — you brought him into my house. You entertain him.
sfx.direction: Not a threat and not a retreat, in his own mind: a delegation. He is already standing, already turning, and does not raise his voice once.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.sauce.mark.scramble-1.1
sfx.say: Mark. Mark! MARK.
sfx.direction: Three attempts at the same word, each one smaller than the last.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.wife.mark.scramble-2.1
sfx.say: He is very fast for a big man. He has always been very fast.
sfx.direction: Flat, admiring, entirely unhelpful. She is watching her husband leave and appraising his gait.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.sauce.sauce.alone-1.1
sfx.say: Twenty years. Twenty years I cooked for that man, and he is going to leave me at the table.
sfx.direction: The realisation arriving in real time, out loud, to nobody. Not frightened yet — insulted.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.sauce.sauce.alone-2.1
sfx.say: Fine. FINE. You want to know what I am, Tony? I am the only one in this house who ever finished anything.
sfx.direction: A chef losing his temper, which is a specific and dangerous kind of temper. He goes for the gun on the last word.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.wife.react.sauce-down-1.1
sfx.say: The CHEF?! Who garnishes the branzino now, you son of a bitch?!
sfx.direction: Screamed fury. The catering implications hit her before the mortality does.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.johnny.react.sauce-down-2.1
sfx.say: He still owed me forty bucks—
sfx.direction: Genuine dismay, already crouching.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.lola.react.sauce-down-3.1
sfx.say: —forty bucks, gone. AWAY from the table. AWAY from the table!
sfx.direction: Finishes the accounting, then the bark, then the dive. All three at full commitment.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.lola.begging.after-sauce-1.1
sfx.say: We do not cook. We never cooked. We carried things for a man who is now on the tablecloth.
sfx.direction: From the floor, fast and reasonable, laying out a position rather than begging. She thinks this is going to work.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.johnny.begging.after-sauce-2.1
sfx.say: We can carry things for you. We are very good at carrying things.
sfx.direction: Helpfully, and flat on his face. He is applying for a job over a corpse and he means it sincerely.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.lola.begging.after-sauce-3.1
sfx.say: That is the whole offer. It is not a big offer.
sfx.direction: Quiet. She knows exactly how small it is and puts it on the table anyway.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.mark.reprisal.enter.cold-1.1
sfx.say: You shot my chef in my dining room. On a Tuesday.
sfx.direction: Back through the door, unhurried, genuinely aggrieved about the day of the week.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.mark.reprisal.enter.cold-2.1
sfx.say: I was going to let you leave here with a theory. Now I have to do the leaving-you-here part myself.
sfx.direction: Reasonable to the last syllable. The rifle comes up on "myself" and nothing in his voice changes.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.mark.reprisal.enter.enraged-1.1
sfx.say: They CARRIED things. That is the whole of what they did in this house. They carried things.
sfx.direction: Not shouted. Said slowly, twice, because he cannot get past it.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.mark.reprisal.enter.enraged-2.1
sfx.say: Nothing in your ledger said to do that. You read my books and then you did that anyway.
sfx.direction: The one moment in the mission where the man is not performing. It should be uncomfortable.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.mark.reprisal.enter.enraged-3.1
sfx.say: Come here.
sfx.direction: Two words, quiet, and he is already moving.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.mark.reprisal.armor-broken-1.1
sfx.say: All right. All right — that is a good rifle.
sfx.direction: Winded, plates gone, and complimenting the weapon. Buying the four seconds it takes to get through the door.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.mark.reprisal.armor-broken-2.1
sfx.say: BOYS. Dining room. Bring everybody.
sfx.direction: Bellowed down a corridor, the first time all night he has raised his voice.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.wife.reprisal.wave-1.1
sfx.say: That is the good crew. He keeps the good crew for weddings.
sfx.direction: From behind the sideboard, appalled at the expense.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.johnny.reprisal.wave-cleared-1.1
sfx.say: They are all on the rug.
sfx.direction: Muffled, from under the table, doing an inventory.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.wife.reprisal.wave-cleared-2.1
sfx.say: They are ALL on the rug.
sfx.direction: The same four words, entirely different grief.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.mark.reprisal.final.cold-1.1
sfx.say: No vest. No boys. No chef.
sfx.direction: Counting what is gone, in a tone that suggests he has done this arithmetic before.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.mark.reprisal.final.cold-2.1
sfx.say: Just the man who came to my house on a Tuesday, and me.
sfx.direction: Almost hospitable. He walks out into the open on purpose.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.mark.reprisal.final.enraged-1.1
sfx.say: They carried things.
sfx.direction: Still on it. He has been standing behind that wall thinking about it.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.mark.reprisal.final.enraged-2.1
sfx.say: Say one word to me about the ledger. Say one word, and I will put you through the wall my wife chose.
sfx.direction: The full thing, finally uncapped. No performance left in it at all.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.wife.react.mark-first-1.1
sfx.say: MARCO! You shot him in the FACE — the deposit, you ANIMAL, the DEPOSIT!
sfx.direction: Screamed over a fresh corpse. Grief and cosmetic-surgery accounting at equal volume.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.lola.react.mark-first-2.1
sfx.say: NOT the table! AWAY from the table!
sfx.direction: One barked correction, already moving. Twenty years of the wrong drill, unlearned mid-air.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.johnny.react.mark-first-3.1
sfx.say: AWAY FROM THE TABLE!
sfx.direction: The identical bark a half-beat later. It is rehearsed. It is finally rehearsed correctly.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.lola.react.dive-landed-1.1
sfx.say: Wall. The WALL is cover. A table is a table.
sfx.direction: Winded, flat on the floor, delivering the correction like somebody who has just lost an argument with physics.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.johnny.react.dive-landed-2.1
sfx.say: I am updating the procedure.
sfx.direction: Muffled and absolutely serious. Somewhere there is a laminated card and he intends to reprint it.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.wife.react.all-down-1.1
sfx.say: FINE! Fine. I hope every rug you ever love betrays you. Now get out of my house, you gorgeous psychopath!
sfx.direction: The full aria: cursing Tony out, vicious and operatic, with one involuntary compliment in the middle.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.lola.react.all-down-2.1
sfx.say: We saw nothing.
sfx.direction: Muffled, from under the table, instantly cooperative.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.johnny.react.all-down-3.1
sfx.say: We are continuing to see nothing.
sfx.direction: Also from under the table, providing ongoing legal coverage.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.lola.react.wife-down-1.1
sfx.say: He shot the missus! The missus is DOWN!
sfx.direction: Genuine panic, announced like a ring judge, already moving.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.johnny.react.wife-down-2.1
sfx.say: On the RUG! She is ON the rug!
sfx.direction: Horrified — for her, and on her behalf about the rug, which she loved.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.johnny.react.lola-down-1.1
sfx.say: LOLA. You had two centimetres on me. Two whole centimetres, and you never once let me forget it.
sfx.direction: Grief measured in the only unit that ever mattered between them.

sfx.name: vo.palace.finale.lola.react.johnny-down-1.1
sfx.say: JOHNNY! You magnificent half-portion — I am not covering your shifts!
sfx.direction: Bereft and furious about the rota in the same scream.

sfx.name: vo.door.refusal.heist_cleanup.1
sfx.say: Not walking into the Bing wearing the bank. Clean up first.

sfx.name: vo.door.refusal.cabin_message.1
sfx.say: Lou sent somewhere to disappear. Read it before driving into the dark.

sfx.name: vo.door.refusal.final_arc_locked.1
sfx.say: Bank’s done. Nobody’s called. And when nobody calls, you sit down.

sfx.name: vo.door.refusal.initiation_locked.1
sfx.say: Lou said seven. The invitation still has to land.

sfx.name: vo.door.refusal.golf_call.1
sfx.say: Lou said he would call about this morning. I am not guessing where.

sfx.name: vo.door.refusal.golf_return.1
sfx.say: Three holes done. Whatever comes next, Lou will call for it.

sfx.name: vo.door.refusal.heist_call.1
sfx.say: Lou said he would call. Today is not a day to guess.

sfx.name: vo.door.refusal.heist_kit.1
sfx.say: Everything Lou named goes with me. Nothing else does.

sfx.name: vo.door.refusal.big_night_call.1
sfx.say: Booskibro said he would call about tonight. I am not turning up unasked.

sfx.name: vo.door.refusal.no_wake_call.1
sfx.say: Lou said he would call when he knew. I am not chasing him today.

sfx.name: vo.door.refusal.date_call.1
sfx.say: She said she would ring about tonight. I am not turning up at nine on a guess.

sfx.name: vo.door.refusal.sleep_after_date.1
sfx.say: That was a good night. Tomorrow is the other kind. Bed.

sfx.name: vo.door.refusal.day_two_call.1
sfx.say: Booskibro said he would call with the next job.

sfx.name: vo.door.refusal.second_bing_call.1
sfx.say: Lou said he would call when he wanted you back at the Bing.

sfx.name: vo.door.refusal.sleep_after_motel.1
sfx.say: It is not even light out. Whatever is next can wait until I have slept.

sfx.name: vo.door.refusal.first_call.1
sfx.say: Big Uncle Lou said he would call. I should answer before I go anywhere.

sfx.name: vo.door.refusal.sleep_after_squatchfather.1
sfx.say: That is enough going out for one night.

sfx.name: vo.door.refusal.lou_package.1
sfx.say: I am not going anywhere until I find Lou’s package.

sfx.name: vo.door.refusal.whiskey.1
sfx.say: Take one pull of whiskey. You earned the nerves.

sfx.name: vo.door.refusal.watch_tv.1
sfx.say: I put a man in the ground last night. I would like to know whether it made the news before I go anywhere.

sfx.name: vo.door.refusal.counter_squatch.1
sfx.say: I told the boys one game. One game, and then I am out the door.

sfx.name: vo.door.refusal.squatch_shoot.1
sfx.say: Lou is going to put a club in my hand in front of people. Something needs warming up and it is not going to be the swing.

sfx.name: vo.door.refusal.squatch_smash.1
sfx.say: Whatever tonight is, it is the last night of something. I would like to wreck a campground first.

sfx.name: vo.door.refusal.shrooms_before.1
sfx.say: They take ninety minutes. Take them now and they land about the time somebody starts making speeches.
